title: Performance & Development Manager
employer: ISMG (International Sales and Marketing Group) AB
description:
About ISMG AB

ISMG AB is a service provider operating within the fast-moving micromobility sector. We work in an environment where efficiency, quality, flexibility and strong operational performance are essential to delivering a reliable service to our clients.

As our organisation continues to develop, we are looking for a Performance & Development Manager to strengthen our team in Stockholm.

This is a key role for someone who combines an analytical and structured approach with a practical understanding of day-to-day operations. You will work closely with company management, the Operations Manager, operational teams and our client to develop our processes, improve performance and support the continued development of the organisation.

About the Role

As Performance & Development Manager, you will be responsible for identifying, developing and implementing improvements across our organisation.

Your focus will be on performance, productivity, quality and continuous improvement. You will analyse operational results, identify opportunities for improvement and turn insights into practical solutions and sustainable working methods.

An important part of the role will be working closely with the Operations Manager and operational teams to understand challenges in the daily operation and develop solutions that create measurable results.

You will also support management by providing analysis, reporting and recommendations that contribute to both operational and strategic decision-making.

This is a hands-on role where you will be expected not only to identify opportunities for improvement, but also to take ownership of implementing and following up those improvements.

Key Responsibilities

Your responsibilities will include:

    Monitor, analyse and develop operational KPIs and performance indicators
    Identify trends, inefficiencies and opportunities to improve productivity, quality and service delivery
    Develop and implement processes, routines and standardised working methods
    Lead continuous improvement initiatives across the organisation
    Analyse operational data and translate findings into practical actions
    Follow up implemented improvements and measure their impact
    Develop reporting structures and provide management with relevant performance insights
    Support the Operations Manager with performance analysis, planning and organisational development
    Work closely with operational teams to identify challenges and develop practical and sustainable solutions
    Lead and coordinate internal development and improvement projects
    Apply Lean, 5S and other continuous improvement methodologies where appropriate
    Develop and maintain process documentation, workflows and operational procedures
    Conduct root cause analysis and coordinate corrective and preventive actions
    Identify opportunities for more efficient use of resources and improved cost efficiency
    Support quality assurance and the achievement of agreed service levels and client expectations
    Contribute to the development and implementation of new working methods and operational initiatives
    Promote a culture of continuous improvement, accountability, collaboration and high performance

Who Are We Looking For?

We are looking for a person who is analytical and improvement-driven while also being comfortable working close to the daily operation.

You enjoy understanding how and why things work, identifying opportunities for improvement and turning ideas into practical solutions.

You are comfortable taking ownership of projects and initiatives and can work independently while maintaining strong collaboration with colleagues, management and external stakeholders.

We believe you have:

    A university degree in engineering, production, logistics, management or another relevant field
    Previous experience in process development, continuous improvement, production, logistics or another operational environment
    Experience leading or coordinating improvement projects
    Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
    Experience working with KPIs, performance measurement and data-driven decision-making
    Knowledge of Lean, 5S or similar continuous improvement methodologies
    Strong Excel skills and confidence working with operational data
    Experience developing processes, workflows and documentation
    Strong organisational and project management skills
    The ability to take ownership and independently drive improvement initiatives from analysis through implementation and follow-up
    Strong communication and collaboration skills
    Professional proficiency in English

Knowledge of Swedish is considered an advantage.

Experience with ERP systems, process mapping, advanced data analysis or other relevant digital tools is also considered an advantage.

Personal Qualities

To succeed in this role, we believe that you are analytical, structured and proactive, with a strong drive to improve both processes and results.

You are results-oriented and enjoy seeing measurable outcomes from the initiatives you implement. At the same time, you understand that sustainable improvements require cooperation and involvement from the people working in the operation.

You communicate effectively with people at different levels of an organisation and are comfortable working with employees, managers, clients and other stakeholders.

You are adaptable and comfortable working in a dynamic environment where priorities can change quickly.

Most importantly, you have a hands-on mindset. You are willing to understand the operation in practice, identify what can be improved and take responsibility for making those improvements happen.

What We Offer

At ISMG AB, you will have the opportunity to take on a role with significant responsibility and a direct impact on how our organisation performs and develops.

You will work closely with both management and our operational organisation and have the opportunity to influence processes, working methods, performance measurement and future development.

The position offers a combination of performance management, process development, project management and continuous improvement within a dynamic and rapidly developing industry.

We value initiative, responsibility and practical problem-solving, and for the right person, this is an opportunity to develop professionally while contributing to the continued growth and development of ISMG AB.

title: Co-Founder / CEO Stockholm - Hybrid/Remote
description:
Co-Founder / CEO – Build the Next Big Tech Company

Start from day one – with capital, customers, and a team behind you

Company Description

This isn’t your typical company – we launch one new tech venture every month.

We develop the idea, validate customer demand, secure funding, and build the initial infrastructure – then we bring in a founder like you to step in as the CEO & co-founder from day one.

You won’t be starting alone. You’ll be building something new, bold, and scalable – but with a team of experienced operators, proven processes, and startup capital behind you.

Our team has founded and scaled companies like Realforce (120+ M ARR) and Minna Technologies (770M exit to Mastercard). Now we’re doing it again – over and over – and we’re looking for founders to build with us.

Our Model

What we provide:

A validated business idea and early customer interest

Startup capital and a full operational support team (tech, finance, legal, growth)

You as CEO & co-founder with equity from day one

A proven framework that creates profitable companies fast

Our Background & Track Record

We’ve launched multiple ventures already, and several became profitable within 12 months.

We select one founder per month to build with – and fully commit our resources to that venture.

This is not an accelerator, incubator, or passive investment – it’s co-building from scratch.

Our Team & Culture

We’re builders – not theorists.

We value speed, ownership, and clarity. Our studio is structured for execution, and we only work with people who have the grit and vision to drive something forward – fast.

You’ll work alongside operators in tech, design, GTM, legal and fundraising – and have the space to make the CEO role your own.

Requirement Profile – Who We're Looking For

We only work with three founder personas. Do you recognize yourself in one of them?

Founder Personas

1. The Growth Hacker

Commercially driven and thrives in sales and GTM

Built sales machines, funnels, teams or grown revenue 0–20M+

Ready to lead and build from scratch – with strong operational support

2. The Ex-Consultant

Background at McKinsey, BCG, Bain or similar

Wants to own a P&L, not just analyze it

Gets things done even in messy, imperfect conditions

Ready to lead a company, not just build decks

3. The Tech Builder

Senior developer or product builder who’s shipped real V1s

Can turn ideas into MVPs in weeks – not months

Has “unshakable conviction” about their ability to solve hard problems

Wants to be CEO and get commercial help from day one

Role Responsibilities

    Step in as CEO & co-founder of a new company
    Lead product development, GTM, hiring and growth
    Work directly with our team for support in sales, marketing, operations, finance, tech and legal
    Build and scale a business from 0 to funding, profitability, or beyond

Your Day-to-Day

    Operate as CEO of a brand-new venture
    Work closely with customers to validate and refine the product
    Collaborate with the team + other portfolio companies to execute and scale
    Recruit early team members
    Set goals and drive traction – fast

Qualifications & Experience

    You’ve built something before – a product, a sales pipeline, a company, or a team
    You’re comfortable with ambiguity and quick decision-making
    You have strong leadership instincts and can own your work
    You match one of our founder personas (Growth, Consulting, Tech)
    You have high “GSDQ” – Get Shit Done Quotient

Traits & Characteristics

    Entrepreneurial mindset
    Action-oriented and strategic thinker
    Clear communicator and team leader
    Quick learner with a hunger for building
    You don’t want a job – you want ownership

Career Growth & Benefits

    30% Equity as co-founder from day one
    Support from a full operational team
    Network, partners and potential investors provided
    High-impact role with startup-level freedom and real backing
    Proven model with real success stories



Compensation: 0 SEK base salary. Salary negotiated within 6 months. 30% equity as Co-Founder from day one.

﻿Interviews are conducted on an ongoing basis, so please submit your application as soon as possible.

You will be employed directly by the company. You will receive information about which company the advertisement refers to when you are in contact with the recruiter. Bumbli Group is therefore not the employer but the recruitment agency.

Welcome to submit your application!

Bumbli Group is part of House of Recruitment — a personal, traditional and quality-driven recruitment agency in Gothenburg.

title: Critical Facility Manager
description:
About the Role:

As a CBRE Critical Facility Manager, you will manage the team responsible for providing preventative maintenance and repair services to an established Sweden based data center operator at the client location.
This job is part of the Critical and Technical Services job function. They are responsible for technical maintenance services in critical client environments.

What You'll Do:


    Provide formal supervision to employees. Monitor the training and development of staff. Conduct performance evaluations and coaching. Oversee the recruiting and hiring of new employees.

    Coordinate and manage the team's daily activities. Establish work schedules, assign tasks, and cross-train staff. Set and track staff and department deadlines. Mentor and coach as needed.

    Manage the relationship with the client while working with other stakeholders to meet all MSA requirements.

    Responsible for ensuring the completion of configuration management, work orders, preventative maintenance, and repairs within the agreed SLA timeframe.

    Resolve unforeseen circumstances that occur and inform the client or Sr. management when needed.

    Verify facility infrastructure equipment installations are within the agreed SLA timeframe.

    Check daily routine cleanup of the data halls and review findings.

    Confirm all deployments are installed to applicable internal, manufacturer, and industry standards.

    Ensure that all records are updated following any changes made. Ensure that documentation is also kept up to date for all applicable processes.

    Prepare Method Statements and Risk Assessments and present to Sr. management.

    Lead by example and model behaviors that are consistent with CBRE RISE values. Influence parties of shared interests to reach an agreement.

    Apply knowledge of own discipline and how own discipline integrates with others to achieve team and departmental objectives.

    Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve day-to-day and moderately complex issues which may or may not be evident in existing systems and processes.


What You'll Need:


    Bachelor's Degree preferred with 3- 5 years of relevant experience. In lieu of a degree, a combination of experience and education will be considered.

    Experience in the areas of staffing, selection, training, development, coaching, mentoring, measuring, appraising, and rewarding performance and retention preferred.

    Ability to guide the exchange of sensitive, complicated, and difficult information, convey performance expectations and handle problems.

    Leadership skills to motivate team impact on quality, efficiency, and effectiveness of the job discipline and department.

    Indepth knowledge of Microsoft Office products. Examples include Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.

    Extensive organizational skills with a strong inquisitive mindset.


Why Join CBRE?


    Be part of a high-performing team in a critical environment

    Work with advanced data center infrastructure

    Be part of a collaborative, supportive, and high-performance culture

    Collaborative and safety-focused workplace

title: Data Center Senior Day Technician
description:
About the Role:

As a CBRE Senior Data Center Day Technician, you will perform preventative maintenance, complex corrective repairs, and technical troubleshooting within a large Data Center operation. You will act as a senior technical resource, supporting the safe and reliable operation of critical infrastructure systems while mentoring technicians and coordinating operational activities across the site. Where appointed, you will serve as the site's Authorising Technician (HVAP), ensuring high-voltage operations are completed safely and in accordance with approved procedures.

What You'll Do:

Maintain an up-to-date log of completed and outstanding work through the site maintenance management system.


    Perform preventative, predictive, and corrective maintenance on critical electrical, mechanical, HVAC, fire/life safety, and monitoring systems.

    Track and complete Planned Preventative Maintenance (PPM) activities and provide equipment condition assessments.

    Act as the senior technical escalation point for operational issues, maintenance activities, and critical incidents.

    Support and coordinate Shift Technicians during daily operations and maintenance activities.

    Provide technical guidance, mentoring, and knowledge sharing to support technician development and operational consistency.

    Act as the site Authorising Technician (HVAP) where appointed, including reviewing and authorizing switching activities, isolations, and permits.

    Ensure all contractors and site personnel comply with company, client, safety, and security requirements.

    Coordinate maintenance activities with contractors, vendors, and operational teams.

    Respond to emergency situations, equipment failures, and customer concerns.

    Log, investigate, and report all out-of-line situations and incident events.

    Maintain effective communication with clients, management, contractors, and site teams.

    Identify opportunities to improve maintenance programs, operational procedures, and equipment reliability.

    Apply advanced technical knowledge to troubleshoot and resolve complex operational issues.


What You'll Need:

    
    Technical apprenticeship, trade qualification, military technical training, or equivalent combination of education and experience.

    Typically 5+ years of experience in Data Center, critical facilities, electrical, mechanical, HVAC, or mission-critical environments.

    Strong knowledge of critical infrastructure systems including electrical distribution, UPS, generators, HVAC, BMS, EPMS, and fire/life safety systems.

    HVAP (High Voltage Authorised Person) certification preferred or ability to achieve authorization.

    Strong understanding of Permit-to-Work, Lock Out/Tag Out (LOTO), switching procedures, and Safe Systems of Work.

    Experience providing technical guidance, mentoring, and support to technicians.

    Ability to analyze and resolve complex technical problems using sound judgment and technical expertise.

    Strong communication and organizational skills with an inquisitive mindset.

    Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office applications including Word, Excel, and Outlook.

    Ability to work flexible schedules and meet the physical requirements of the role.

Why Join CBRE?


    Be part of a high-performing team in a critical environment
    Work with advanced data center infrastructure
    Be part of a collaborative, supportive, and high-performance culture
    Collaborative and safety-focused workplace

title: Tech Lead
description:
About Evora Labs

Evora Labs develops technology for the operation, integration, and management of battery energy storage systems and other distributed energy assets.

Our platform helps energy asset owners integrate assets, achieve market readiness, maintain operational availability, and manage technical requirements across energy markets and grid  services.

About the role

As Tech Lead, you will own the technical direction and day-to-day engineering of the Evora platform: the cloud backend, the operator frontend, the EMS edge software that runs at battery sites, and the infrastructure that connects them.

  You will work close to real assets. The code you write reads Modbus registers from live battery systems, runs prequalification tests against the Swedish TSO's technical requirements, ingests Nordic and continental market data, and dispatches setpoints that a safety envelope on the edge is the last line of defense for.

  The position combines hands-on full-stack development, system architecture, ownership of the edge and integration layer, technical leadership of a small team, and continuous translation of  field experience from live BESS projects into the product.

Key responsibilities

  - Own the architecture and technical roadmap of the Evora platform across backend, frontend, edge, and cloud infrastructure.

  - Design and build backend services in Python (FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, asyncpg, Alembic) on top of TimescaleDB, Redis, and MQTT.

  - Develop and maintain the EMS edge software: Modbus and vendor-protocol drivers, register maps, control loops, safety envelope, and store-and-forward telemetry over AWS IoT Core.

  - Build operator-facing product in the Next.js and React frontend: fleet monitoring, asset and site management, the visual workflow builder, dashboards, and market explorers.

  - Own the prequalification engine that drives FCR-N, FCR-D, FFR, aFRR, and mFRR test programs, validates the response against TSO technical requirements, and produces the evidence and

    application values.

  - Integrate battery management systems, power conversion systems, meters, inverters, EV chargers, and heat pumps through Modbus, vendor cloud APIs, and gateway hardware.

  - Build and operate the market-data pipelines (ENTSO-E, Svenska kraftnät, Nord Pool style sources) that feed spot, ancillary, and forecast views.

  - Extend the platform's agent layer: LLM-driven operations assistants, morning briefings, diagnosis and remediation workflows, and the AI workflow builder, using Claude on AWS Bedrock.

  - Run the AWS infrastructure with Terraform: EC2, IoT Core, ECR, S3, IAM, and the CI/CD pipeline that ships backend images and the Vercel-hosted frontend.

  - Keep the full-system test suite (app, broker, edge, database) green and extend it as the control loop grows.

  - Support commissioning of live BESS sites together with the operations and prequalification team, and investigate communication, control-system, and data issues in the field.

  - Set engineering standards for code review, testing, migrations, observability, and documentation, and grow the team as Evora scales.

  - Contribute technical expertise in customer discovery, partner integrations, and pre-sales discussions.

Qualifications

We are looking for someone who has built and operated production software end to end and who is comfortable going from a battery's register map to a React component in the same day.

  You should have:

  - University degree in computer science, software engineering, electrical engineering, automation, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

  - Several years of professional experience building and operating backend systems in Python, preferably with FastAPI or a similar async framework.

  - Strong SQL and PostgreSQL skills, and experience with time-series data at scale (TimescaleDB, continuous aggregates, compression, partitioning).

  - Experience building modern web frontends with TypeScript and React, preferably Next.js.

  - Experience with industrial or IoT communication: Modbus TCP/RTU, MQTT, or comparable protocols, and with software that runs on edge devices or gateways.

  - Experience running software on AWS or a comparable cloud, including infrastructure as code (Terraform), containers, and CI/CD.

  - Ability to read technical documentation, device specifications, and grid or market requirements, and turn them into working, tested software.

  - Experience leading technical work: setting architecture, reviewing code, and mentoring engineers.

  Meritorious experience

  It is considered an advantage if you have experience with:

  - Battery energy storage systems, EMS, BMS, PCS, meters, or other distributed energy resources.

  - Nordic ancillary-service markets and prequalification for FCR, aFRR, mFRR, or FFR.

  - Electricity-market data sources such as ENTSO-E, Svenska kraftnät, or Nord Pool.

  - LLM-based applications, tool-calling agents, or AI-assisted operational tooling.

  - Workflow or orchestration engines (Temporal or similar) and event-driven architectures.

  - Federated learning or privacy-preserving analytics on distributed data.

  - Edge hardware, balena or similar fleet management, and cellular gateways.

  - Full-system or hardware-in-the-loop testing of control systems.

Personal profile

You are technically hands-on and enjoy owning a system from the field device up to the user interface.

You work systematically, write code that others can read and test, and are comfortable investigating problems that span hardware, communications, databases, and user-facing product.

What we offer

  You will join Evora Labs at an early stage and take a central role in shaping how distributed energy assets are integrated, qualified, and operated through software.

  The position provides the opportunity to work across the whole stack, from Modbus registers on a battery site to market participation and AI-assisted operations, and to set the technical direction of a growing engineering team.

  The role is based in Stockholm.

title: Construction Manager
description:
Why RLB?

At RLB, we live by four simple ideas: Truth, Trust, Together, Tomorrow. Four values that live at the heart of RLB. A place where People Make Progress.

We value your skills, talents and unique perspectives – we think they are priceless.

Bring them to RLB and you’ll be empowered to shape our future and your career in new and meaningful ways.

We’ll give you opportunities to work on some of the most ambitious and exciting projects currently being designed and developed in the built environment sector.

You’ll continue to learn and advance as everyone who works for us is provided with a tailored training programme. Our mentoring and reverse mentoring schemes will enable you to share your expertise while gaining fresh insights.

What makes RLB unique is our inclusive culture. As an independent, employee-owned business, teamwork and collaboration lies at the heart of everything we do. Hybrid and flexible working arrangements and family-friendly policies are just some of the ways we invest in employee wellbeing.

Join us and you will thrive personally as well as professionally.

Role overview:

We are looking for an experienced Construction Manager to oversee the safe, efficient and high-quality delivery of complex construction projects.

This role would suit a construction professional with a strong technical foundation and experience delivering major building or civil engineering projects within live, operational or logistically challenging environments.

Key Responsibilities

Project Delivery

    Lead the planning, coordination and delivery of construction activities in accordance with the agreed programme, budget and quality requirements.
    Develop, review and actively manage construction programmes, identifying opportunities to improve sequencing, productivity and overall delivery.
    Plan site activities in detail, establish clear milestones and accurately forecast completion dates.
    Monitor progress against programme and implement recovery measures where activities are at risk of delay.

Site and Subcontractor Management

    Provide daily leadership and direction to site teams, engineering resources, subcontractors and direct labour.
    Manage subcontractor performance against programme, quality, safety and commercial expectations.
    Coordinate labour, materials, plant, access and site logistics to support efficient delivery.
    Review short-term programmes, method statements, risk assessments and resource requirements.

Health, Safety and Environment

    Champion a strong health, safety and environmental culture across the project.
    Ensure construction activities comply with company procedures, project requirements and applicable legislation.
    Review and contribute to Risk Assessments and Method Statements, Project Management Plans and Construction Phase Plans.
    Ensure required permits, licences and approvals are in place before work begins.

Quality Management

    Ensure works are completed in accordance with approved designs, specifications, inspection plans and quality standards.
    Manage inspection and test plans, hold-point inspections and quality records.
    Identify, record and support the closure of non-conformance reports.

Design and Technical Coordination

    Work closely with design teams to resolve queries and ensure information is available in line with the construction programme.
    Review construction information for buildability, coordination and sequencing.
    Raise and manage Requests for Information and support the timely resolution of technical issues.
    Coordinate engineering, structural, envelope, civils, landscaping and building-services interfaces as applicable to the project.

Commercial and Contractual Support

    Work closely with the commercial team to monitor project performance and provide accurate progress information.
    Support the identification, assessment and management of changes to the works.
    Maintain records that support commercial reporting, forecasting and change control.
    Review material, plant and labour requirements, supporting accurate cost and resource planning.
    Identify delivery risks and opportunities and escalate them to the relevant project leadership team.
    Contribute to regular project reporting covering programme, cost, quality, safety and key risks.
    

Candidate profile:

You will be able to demonstrate:

    Significant experience in construction or civil engineering project delivery.
    Experience working as a Construction Manager, Site Manager, Package Manager or in a comparable construction leadership position.
    A strong understanding of construction programming, sequencing, logistics and resource planning.
    Experience managing subcontractors and multidisciplinary site teams.
    Strong knowledge of health, safety, environmental and quality-management requirements.
    Experience reviewing Risk Assessments and Method Statements and contributing to construction-management documentation.
    The ability to interpret technical drawings, specifications and design information.
    Experience coordinating design teams and resolving technical or buildability issues.
    An understanding of commercial reporting, cost control, forecasting and change management.
    Experience delivering works within complex, live or operational environments.
    Strong written and verbal communication skills.
    The ability to build effective relationships with clients, consultants, contractors and operational stakeholders.
    A proactive, organised and solutions-focused approach.
    Competence in Microsoft Office applications and construction reporting tools.

Qualifications

    A qualification in construction management, civil engineering or a related discipline, such as an HNC, HND, degree or equivalent practical experience.
    A recognised site-management health and safety qualification would be advantageous.
    Temporary Works Coordinator training would be advantageous.
    First Aid, fire coordination or other relevant construction-site certifications would be beneficial.
    A full driving licence may be required, depending on project location.

Desirable Experience

Experience in one or more of the following areas would be beneficial:

    Data centres or other mission-critical facilities.
    Major commercial or public-sector developments.
    Civil engineering and infrastructure works.
    Healthcare, education, defence or secure environments.
    Structural frames, substructures, deep basements and building-envelope packages.
    Refurbishment and regeneration projects.
    Public-realm and external-works packages.
    NEC or other standard construction contracts.
    Testing, commissioning, completion and operational handover.

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (ML & Data) Stockholm - Hybrid
description:
Senior Full-Stack Engineer (ML & Data)

Own our prediction models from training pipeline to customer-facing feature. Strong applied ML — calibration, evals, leakage — plus full-stack TypeScript to ship it.

We build AI agents that audit and optimize e-commerce advertising. Our platform syncs live data from Google Ads, Meta, Merchant Center, and Google Analytics, runs it through a rule engine, LLM-powered audit agents, and our own prediction models, and turns findings into concrete actions marketers can apply with one click.

What sets us apart is measurement: we connect real profit data from our customers' e-commerce platforms to their ad accounts and build models that tell them what their marketing actually returns — not what ad platforms self-report. The ML in our product isn't decoration. Prediction models, calibration, and evaluation pipelines are core to what customers pay for.

We're a small team shipping fast on a modern, strictly-typed stack. You'd report directly to the CTO, with real ownership: features you design end-to-end, and models you own from training data to the number a customer sees on screen.

The role

This is a hybrid role — roughly 60% product engineering, 40% ML & data science. You'll ship full-stack features in our TypeScript monorepo and own prediction models as production software: framing the problem, building training and evaluation pipelines, monitoring calibration drift, and wiring outputs into the product.

We're not looking for a research scientist, or a pure web engineer. We want someone who treats a model the way a good engineer treats a service: tested, monitored, versioned, and honest about its failure modes.

What you'll do

    Own prediction models end-to-end — models that predict product returns and net profit per order — training data pipelines, feature engineering, evaluation (ranking quality and calibration), recalibration strategies, and serving model output into the product.
    Build and maintain data pipelines — SQL feature builders on PostgreSQL shared by training and serving, versioned dataset exports, backfills, and data quality checks that keep training data honest (no leakage, no silent schema drift).
    Design and build features across our TypeScript monorepo — tRPC procedures and NestJS services on the backend, React on the frontend — so model insights become actions marketers can apply with one click.
    Work on the AI audit agent — prompt design, rule evaluation, structured-output evals, and plumbing that turns LLM output into reliable, deduplicated actions across multiple model providers.
    Extend integration workers — sync campaign, product, and analytics data from Google and Meta APIs via Cloud Pub/Sub pipelines.
    Evolve the data model in PostgreSQL/Prisma — keep migrations, multi-tenancy, and role-based access clean as the product grows.
    Own quality — write tests (Jest on TypeScript, pytest on Python), review PRs, and keep our CI/CD pipeline to Cloud Run fast and boring.

Our stack

Backend — TypeScript, Node, js, NestJS + Fastify, tRPC, Zod, Prisma, PostgreSQL, ML & data — Python, pandas, scikit-learn, XGBoost, PyTorch, ONNX, SQL on PostgreSQL, BigQuery, Calibration pipelines, Bayesian MMM (Google Meridian)

Model serving — FastAPI on Cloud Run · Cloud Run Jobs · GPU training on GCP Batch

Frontend — React · Vite · Tailwind · End-to-end types via tRPC

Infrastructure — Google Cloud Run · Pub/Sub · Docker · Terraform · GitHub Actions · pnpm workspaces

AI & integrations — Multiple LLM providers · Google Ads · Meta · Merchant Center · GA4

What we're looking for

    5+ years building production software, with strong TypeScript on both server and client — or strong TypeScript on one side plus deep Python, with the willingness to close the gap fast.
    Hands-on applied ML: you've trained, evaluated, and shipped prediction models that real users depended on. You can explain the difference between good ranking and good calibration, know what data leakage looks like, and have debugged a model that was confidently wrong.
    Fluent Python for data work (pandas, scikit-learn or similar) and strong SQL — comfortable with large datasets in PostgreSQL or BigQuery.
    Solid relational database instincts — schema design, migrations, and query performance in PostgreSQL (Prisma is a plus).
    Experience with event-driven or queue-based architectures (Pub/Sub, SQS, Kafka, or similar) and their failure modes.
    A habit of testing: you write tests because they let you move faster, not because someone told you to.
    Pragmatic product sense — you ask why before how, and you'd rather ship a focused, well-measured model than a state-of-the-art one nobody can maintain.

Nice to have

    Bayesian modeling or marketing mix modeling experience (priors, ROI calibration, health diagnostics).
    Hands-on work with LLM APIs in production — prompting, evals, structured output, cost control, switching providers.
    Experience serving models on GCP (Cloud Run, GCP Batch, Vertex AI) and monitoring for drift.
    Familiarity with Google Ads, Meta, or Merchant Center APIs, or ad-tech / e-commerce domain experience.
    NestJS, tRPC, or GCP (Cloud Run, Artifact Registry, Workload Identity) in a previous role.

How we work

Small team, short feedback loops, no ceremony for ceremony's sake. Strict TypeScript, code review on everything, CI that deploys to Cloud Run on merge. Models are held to the same standard as code: evaluated before they ship, monitored after. We optimize for shipping value weekly and keeping the codebase a place people enjoy working in.

We're a fast-growing team building AI agents that handle the repetitive work — so companies can focus on vision, strategy, and innovation. Here, you'll own ideas from first sketch to finished product, work closely with the founders, and see your impact immediately. We celebrate success, learn from challenges, and believe true magic happens through collaboration.

Want to shape the future of AI-driven marketing?

Interviews are conducted on an ongoing basis, so please submit your application as soon as possible.

You will be employed directly by the company. You will receive information about which company the advertisement refers to when you are in contact with the recruiter. Bumbli Group is therefore not the employer but the recruitment agency.

title: CNC-operatör till avancerad bearbetning
description:
Company description:

Epiroc is a leading productivity partner for the mining, infrastructure and natural resources industries. With cutting-edge technology, Epiroc develops and produces innovative drill rigs, rock excavation and construction equipment, and provides world-class service and consumables. The company was founded in Stockholm, Sweden, and has passionate people supporting and collaborating with customers in more than 150 countries. Learn more at www.epirocgroup.com.

Job description:

Vill du arbeta med avancerad bearbetning, moderna maskiner och produkter som används över hela världen?

Hos Epiroc i Kalmar får du mer än bara ett jobb vid maskinen. Du får arbeta i en högteknologisk produktionsmiljö där din yrkesskicklighet värdesätts, där kvalitet och säkerhet alltid går först – och där du som erfaren CNC‑operatör verkligen kan göra skillnad.

Allt börjar med människor. Människor som du.

Bli en del av vårt teamVi befinner oss i en tillväxtfas och söker nu skickliga CNC‑operatörer som vill vara med och bygga framtidens produktion tillsammans med oss. Här finns långsiktighet, stabilitet och utvecklingsmöjligheter för dig som vill ta nästa steg – hos ett företag som satsar på framtiden.

Epiroc i Kalmar tillverkar världsledande hydrauliska produkter till gruv‑ och anläggningsindustrin – och nu breddar och vidareutvecklar vi vårt produktutbud. Det innebär investeringar i ny teknik, automation, och nya metoder för bearbetning och värmebehandling. Nyfiken på att bli med på resan? Läs mer om Epiroc i Kalmar här.

Ditt uppdrag Som CNC‑operatör hos oss får du arbeta med komponenter och produkter där kraven på precision, kvalitet och spårbarhet är höga. Det du tillverkar används i krävande miljöer världen över – vilket ställer höga krav, men också ger en tydlig stolthet i arbetet.

Maskinbearbetningen bedrivs i moderna fleroperationsmaskiner och svarvar, och kommer inom kort även att omfatta slipning. I rollen ingår ett helhetsansvar för dina maskiner och arbeten, vilket bland annat innebär:


    Självständig körning och övervakning av CNC‑maskiner
    Planering av det dagliga arbetet och hantering av tillverkningsorder
    Verktygshantering och processnära kvalitetsarbete
    Daglig tillsyn av maskiner, utrustning och arbetsmiljö

Din profilVi söker dig som är noggrann, ansvarstagande och trivs i en miljö där teknik, problemlösning och ständig utveckling är en naturlig del av vardagen. Ditt intresse och engagemang för bearbetning gör att du gärna delar med dig av din erfarenhet, testar nya arbetssätt och bidrar till ett stabilt och effektivt produktionsflöde, alltid med stort fokus på säkerhet och kvalitet.

Vi ser gärna att du har:


    Erfarenhet av arbete som CNC‑operatör, alternativt relevant CNC‑utbildning kombinerad med praktisk erfarenhet
    God datorvana för dokumentation, rapportering och produktionsuppföljning
    Goda kunskaper i svenska, i både tal och skrift

Vill du utvecklas vidare inom skärande bearbetning och samtidigt vara med och forma framtidens produktion med oss? Då ser vi fram emot din ansökan.

Placering och arbetstiderDenna tjänst är placerad i Kalmar, Sverige. Arbetet är förlagt till kontinuerligt skiftarbete, vilket innebär att du behöver vara flexibel och trivas med ett rullande schema.

Livet på Epiroc När du blir en del av Epiroc kan du förvänta dig en atmosfär av kreativitet, innovation och mångfald. title: IT-avdelningen söker samordnare inom identiteter och behörigheter
description:
Vill du ha en nyckelroll i arbetet med säkra digitala identiteter, behörigheter och moderna IT-tjänster? Vill du samtidigt vara med och forma en IT-avdelning under uppbyggnad, där du får möjlighet att påverka arbetssätt, processer och tekniska lösningar?

Falkenbergs kommun befinner sig i en spännande utvecklingsfas där vi stärker och vidareutvecklar vår IT-funktion för att möta framtidens krav på digitalisering, säkerhet och effektiv service. Nu söker vi en engagerad och tekniskt kunnig samordnare inom identitet och behörighet som vill ta ett helhetsansvar för kommunens identitets- och behörighetslösningar, samt bidra till att bygga en stabil och framtidssäker digital infrastruktur.

Det här är en roll för dig som vill kombinera teknik, säkerhet, verksamhetsförståelse och samarbete – och som motiveras av att bygga något långsiktigt som gör verklig samhällsnytta.

Här i Falkenbergs kommun kan du göra stor skillnad. Vårt jobb är att erbjuda god kommunal service i livets alla skeden. Vi är också med och utvecklar Falkenberg som plats. Vår vision är att vi växer för en hållbar framtid.

1 plats(er).

ARBETSUPPGIFTER
Som samordnare inom identitet och behörighet ansvarar du för kommunens identitets- och behörighetsplattformar samt processer för användarhantering, autentisering och behörighetsstyrning. Du säkerställer att våra lösningar fungerar effektivt, säkert och i linje med verksamhetens behov, aktuella regelverk och kommunens övergripande mål för digitalisering och informationssäkerhet.

Rollen är både operativ, samordnande och utvecklingsinriktad. Du arbetar nära tekniken, men också med processer, kravställning, dokumentation, uppföljning och samverkan. Eftersom IT-avdelningen är under uppbyggnad får du goda möjligheter att påverka hur vi organiserar, utvecklar och framtids säkrar området identitet och behörighet.

I rollen kommer du bland annat att:

    • förvalta och vidareutveckla kommunens principer och arbetssätt för identitets- och behörighetshantering
    • ansvara för och vidareutveckla lösningar inom Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, PhenixID och Active Roles från One Identity
    • säkerställa effektiva och säkra processer för användarhantering, autentisering och behörighetsstyrning
    • bidra till utvecklingen av kommunens arbete inom IAM, Identity and Access Management
    • vara beställare och kravställare gentemot externa leverantörer och outsourcingpartner
    • delta i utvecklingsprojekt inom digitalisering, informationssäkerhet och systemintegration
    • arbeta med uppföljning, förbättring och dokumentation av processer, rutiner och arbetssätt
    • samverka med verksamheter, systemförvaltare, IT-kollegor och externa leverantörer
    • bidra till en mer sammanhållen, säker och framtidssäker digital infrastruktur för hela kommunen

KVALIFIKATIONER
Vi söker dig som har ett stort intresse för identitetshantering, digitala plattformar, informationssäkerhet och moderna IT-miljöer. Du är strukturerad, ansvarstagande och säkerhetsmedveten och har förmåga att omsätta verksamhetsbehov till fungerande tekniska lösningar.

Du trivs i en roll där teknik, verksamhet och samarbete möts. Du arbetar självständigt och driver initiativ framåt, samtidigt som du är en lagspelare som kommunicerar tydligt och skapar goda relationer med både kollegor, verksamheter och leverantörer.

För att trivas hos oss behöver du uppskatta att arbeta i en miljö där allt inte är färdigbyggt. Du ser möjligheter i att skapa struktur, utveckla arbetssätt och bidra till långsiktiga lösningar.

För rollen behöver du ha;

    • eftergymnasial utbildning inom IT, eller annan utbildning eller erfarenhet som arbetsgivaren bedömer likvärdig
    • erfarenhet av förvaltning eller administration av Microsoft Active Directory och Microsoft Entra ID
    • erfarenhet av Microsoft 365
    • erfarenhet av processutveckling och systemförvaltning, exempelvis ITIL, PM3 eller liknande
    • god förståelse för identitets- och behörighetshantering
    • god förmåga att uttrycka dig på svenska i tal och skrift

Det är meriterande om du har;

    • erfarenhet av IAM-lösningar, Identity and Access Management
    • erfarenhet av PhenixID eller liknande Identity Provider-lösningar
    • erfarenhet av One Identity Active Roles eller motsvarande verktyg
    • kunskap om systemintegrationer och automatiserade användarflöden
    • erfarenhet av arbete inom offentlig sektor eller kommunal verksamhet
    • kunskap inom informationssäkerhet, exempelvis ISO 27001, NIS2 eller cybersäkerhetsarbete
    • erfarenhet av leverantörsstyrning och beställarroll
    • erfarenhet av att bygga upp eller vidareutveckla processer, arbetssätt och styrning inom IT

Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet.

Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning.
Varaktighet: Tillsvidare, tillträde: Tillträde efter överenskommelse.

Hos oss får du:

    • vara med och bygga upp en modern och framtidssäker IT-funktion
    • arbeta med samhällsviktig IT där säkerhet och digitalisering är prioriterade områden
    • kompetenta och engagerade kollegor
    • flexibla arbetsformer och god balans mellan arbete och fritid
    • möjlighet till kompetensutveckling inom moderna tekniker och arbetssätt

Intervjuer kan komma att ske löpande, så skicka gärna in din ansökan så snart som möjligt.

För att kvalitetssäkra rekryteringsprocessen i Falkenbergs kommun använder vi rekryteringsverktyget Visma Recruit. Därför ber vi dig att skicka in din ansökan via Visma Recruit genom att klicka på ansökningslänken i annonsen

Du som söker jobb och har skyddade personuppgifter ska kontakta rekryterande chef i annonsen som kommer guida dig vidare för en säker ansökningsprocess. Du ska inte ansöka digitalt via ansökningslänken.

I samband med denna rekrytering undanber vi oss kontakter från rekryteringsföretag och andra annonsörer.

Tjänsten är säkerhetsklassad och en säkerhetsprövning kommer att genomföras.

title: Commissioning Engineer Processing Liquid Food Solutions
description:
At Tetra Pak we commit to making food safe and available, everywhere; and we protect what's good – protecting food, protecting people, and protecting the planet. By doing so we touch millions of people's lives every day.

And we need people like you to make it happen.

We empower you to reach your potential with opportunities to make an impact to be proud of – for food, people and the planet.

Job Summary

Processing Liquid Food Solutions is responsible for development and manufacturing of solutions and branded processing units for the processing of liquid foods within dairy, beverage, prepared food, and plant based. We work closely with our market operations and customers to understand their true needs. To secure that we, create and convey our solutions that provide the greatest value for Tetra Pak and its Customers. Processing Liquid Food Solutions has approx. 350 employees in five main sites: Sweden, China, Mexico, USA, India, Singapore.



We are looking for a Commissioning Engineer that will have a key role in providing technical service to our Market Companies and end customers.



The position is permanent and preferably based in Lund, but you may be located at any Tetra Pak Processing office. The role includes up to 150 travel days per year.

What you will do

The work is project based and will give you the opportunity to work with the latest technologies. Your main task will be to test, start-up and fine-tune our solutions, both our branded processing units and complete process lines, at our production site and at end-customer’s factories all over the world. You will also have a key role in building competence in the team. We can offer you a very interesting position and an opportunity to grow and become professional in one of our core technologies for food processing.



You will focus on

    Commissioning, start-up and troubleshooting of branded processing units and process lines at our customer’s sites.
    Delivery tests performed in our engineering workshops.
    Technical training and support to Tetra Pak´s Market Companies.

We believe you have

You have a technical education and are knowledgeable within automation. Mechanical engineering and hands-on work experience are beneficial, since you will handle a wide range of work tasks in this position. Your English is fluent, both written and spoken.

Driving license is required.



We are looking for strong, independent colleagues with high personal drive. Since the position involves world-wide travelling, you need to have strong social skills and the ability to adjust. At our customers´ sites you will take a supervising role, and it is therefore important that you are communicative, flexible and result oriented. You also need to have a systematic approach and good documentation skills. General processing knowledge will be considered as an advantage.

We Offer You

    A culture that pioneers a spirit of innovation where our industry experts drive visible results

title: PhD Student in Robotics and Artificial Intelligence
description:
Are you ready to take the next step in your academic journey? As a doctoral student with us, you will work closely with leading researchers in a strong, international research environment, with access to advanced laboratory equipment and solid funding opportunities. You will be offered secure employment, high-quality supervision, and room to grow, both as a researcher and as a person.

https://www.ltu.se/research/subjects/RoboticsAI?l=en subject, RAI, at the Department of Computer Science and Electrical and Space Engineering at Luleå University of Technology, is now looking for a PhD student to contribute to our growing activities. The RAI team is conducting fundamental research in all the aspects of robotics with a specific focus on aerial, space and bioinspired robotics.



Subject description

Robotics and artificial intelligence aim to develop novel robotic systems that are characterized by advanced autonomy for improving the ability of robots to interact with the surrounding environment and humans during the execution of specific tasks.



Project description

The vision of RAI is aiming in closing the gap from theory to real life, while the team has a strong expertise in field robotics. Specific application areas of focus are long-term autonomous missions in large and uncertain environments, semantic mission planning with foundation models, agentic task decomposition and event-driven re-planning, and autonomous semantic-aware inspection of complex infrastructure. The RAI team has a strong European and National participation in multiple R&D&I projects.



Duties

As a PhD student you will perform research with substantial theoretical and experimental components that should be published in peer-reviewed major international journals and at major conferences. The position will include supervision of MSc and to assist in grant applications from research funding agencies/councils, the EU framework program or the industry. The position might also involve teaching assistance, seminars and presentations.

You will be working in the field of robotic autonomy, and all activities will be linked with National, European and worldwide R&D Projects.

The research topic is in Robotics and Artificial Intelligence. More specifically, the position will involve dense research activities in designing, experimenting and theoretical development, with the following research areas providing a template for relevant directions:



Long-term Autonomy in Uncertain Environments

    Agentic Planning and Reasoning

    Semantic Mission Planning with Foundation Models
    Foundation models based task decomposition
    Event-driven task re-planning

    Autonomous Inspection Planning

    Semantic-aware Path Planning
    Multi-robot systems in large and degraded environments



Qualifications

To be qualified for the position, you must have an MSc degree in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related subject. Proficiency in C++, Python, and ROS 2 is required. Strong scientific skills with proven excellence in real-life experimentation, as well as very good communication skills, are considered a strong plus. You will represent the group on different occasions, both in Sweden and worldwide, so very good command of English is a must.

For further information about a specific subject see http://www.ltu.se/research/Utbildning-pa-forskarniva/Studieplaner/Allmanna-studieplaner-Teknisk-fakultetsnamnd?l=en



Further information

Employment as a PhD student is limited to 4 years, teaching and other department duties may be added with max 20%. Placement: Luleå. Starting: According to agreement

title: Security & Compliance Specialist - Gothenburg or Hälsingland
description:
Help us build trust, strengthen resilience, and shape the future of compliance in a growing software company.

At Bjorn Lunden, we develop software and services that help businesses manage critical financial and administrative processes. Every day, thousands of customers trust us with sensitive data and business-critical information, making security, transparency, and compliance a natural part of everything we do.

We're now looking for a Security & Compliance Specialist who wants to help strengthen our work within governance, risk, security, and compliance. If you enjoy turning regulatory requirements into practical business solutions and collaborating across both business and technology, we'd love to hear from you.

About the Role

As a Security & Compliance Specialist, you will play an important role in developing and strengthening Bjorn Lunden Group's work within information security, compliance, governance, and risk management.

Working closely with our Security & Compliance Officer and colleagues across IT, Development, Operations, Product, and Management, you will help ensure that our processes, controls, and regulatory requirements are translated into practical and effective ways of working.

This role offers the opportunity to work at the intersection of business, technology, and regulation, supporting initiatives within ISO 27001, NIS2, DORA, GDPR, ISAE 3000, and AI governance while helping strengthen security and compliance across the Group.

You will:

    Support control monitoring, audit readiness, and ongoing compliance activities
    Maintain and improve policies, documentation, and governance processes
    Support process owners and stakeholders in strengthening governance, controls, and risk-based ways of working
    Contribute to compliance initiatives related to ISO 27001, NIS2, DORA, GDPR, and the EU AI Ac
    Monitor regulatory developments and help assess their impact on the business
    Perform gap analyses and follow up on improvement initiatives
    Advise stakeholders across the business on security, risk, and compliance matters
    Support customer audits, security questionnaires, and compliance inquiries
    Create awareness and training materials that strengthen security culture across the Group

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who wants to build broad expertise within information security and compliance while working close to both technology and business.

About You

We're looking for someone who combines analytical thinking with strong collaboration and communication skills. You enjoy bringing structure to complexity and can translate security and compliance requirements into practical actions that support the business.

We believe you have:

    1-3 years of experience within information security, compliance, audit, risk management, privacy, or IT governance
    Knowledge of frameworks and regulations such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, ISAE 3000/3402, GDPR, or similar
    A structured and detail-oriented way of working
    Strong communication skills and the ability to engage both technical and non-technical stakeholders
    The confidence to challenge existing processes and identify opportunities for improvement
    Fluent Swedish and strong written and verbal communication skills in English. Proficiency in Dutch or Danish is considered an advantage.

A degree within information security, IT, business administration, law, risk management, audit, or a related field is preferred, but we also value equivalent work experience and practical knowledge.

Certifications such as ISO 27001 Foundation, CISA, CRISC, CISSP, CISM, CIPP/E, CIPT, or similar are considered an advantage. Most importantly, you have a genuine interest in continuous learning and professional development within the security and compliance field.

Who We Are

We are Bjorn Lunden, the business platform that simplifies everyday life for small and medium-sized businesses. Our belief is simple: every business deserves opportunities to grow, and we’re here to make that happen 🐻.

We’re on an exciting journey. With bold ambitions, our vision is to become one of the leading providers of accounting and financial software solutions in Northwestern Europe. With our roots in Hälsingland, specifically in the small village of Näsviken, we’ve grown rapidly in recent years, transforming from a smaller national company into an international group. Today, we operate in Sweden, the Netherlands, and Denmark.

Our goal is straightforward: to make life a little easier for entrepreneurs and business owners. We believe we can do that through great software, knowledge, innovation, and TACO. Not the kind you might be thinking of - but our version: Trust, Ambition, Collaboration, and Ownership.

What We Offer

We offer you a role in an international, growing company with a strong market position and the ambition to challenge industry giants. The wellbeing of our employees truly matters to us, and we want to be a fair and responsible employer where people feel good and enjoy their work.

We strive for a healthy work-life balance and support this through competitive conditions and benefits and flexible work opportunities. We want to be the natural first choice for people who want to thrive and have fun at work.

Application

We are looking for a Security & Compliance Specialist located in Gothenburg, Stockholm, Hudiksvall, Näsviken, or Ljusdal.

The application deadline is 4th October 2026, but selection and interviews may take place on an ongoing basis. The position may therefore be filled before the deadline, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Robert Dahlin, Group Head of IT Robert.Dahlin@bjornlunden.com

title: Process Engineer
description:
Shape the Future of Sustainable Industrial Processes as a Process Engineer

We are looking for a Process Engineer to join our Project Execution organization within the Pulp & Energy Business Unit. In this role, you will support process engineering activities related to Recovery and Fibre Line technologies for the pulp and paper industry, as well as power boiler solutions for demanding fuels. You will work closely with Lead Process Engineers and collaborate with several engineering disciplines across sales, customer delivery, and development projects. The position offers the opportunity to contribute to a wide range of technical projects while developing your expertise within industrial process systems.  

The role can be based in either Gothenburg or Sundsvall.

Your responsibilities

    You will specify piping requirements and perform pipe dimensioning to support efficient process solutions.

Expectations for you

    You have a degree in engineering, preferably within chemical engineering, thermal engineering, or a related field.  
    You have previous experience from a similar engineering role within industry.  
    You are familiar with engineering tools such as COMOS, AutoCAD, Adobe Illustrator, or comparable P&ID management systems.  
    You have strong communication skills and a systematic approach to problem-solving.  
    You have professional proficiency in both Swedish and English.  

Travel is required occasionally as part of the role.

To succeed in this role

To succeed, you bring solid process engineering expertise and the ability to work effectively across multiple disciplines. You are comfortable handling technical details while maintaining a broader project perspective. Your structured approach, collaborative mindset, and ability to communicate clearly with colleagues and stakeholders will help you create successful project outcomes and deliver value to customers.  

We offer

You will join a team of engineering professionals working with some of the industry's most advanced process technologies. Valmet offers an inspiring and challenging position where you can contribute to sustainable industrial solutions. When everything works together

Valmet is where the best talent from a wide variety of backgrounds comes together. Backed by more than 225 years of industrial experience and a global team of over 19,000 professionals close to customers, we are uniquely positioned to transform industries toward a regenerative tomorrow. At Valmet, diversity of thought drives innovation. We are committed to a respectful and inclusive environment, where people can be themselves and are supported to contribute at their best. title: Data & Insight Specialist at Arla - Stockholm
description:
Are you passionate about turning data into insights that create real business value? Do you enjoy combining analytical expertise with commercial understanding and working closely with stakeholders to influence decisions?

We are looking for a Data & Insight Specialist to join our team at Arla’s head office in Solna, Stockholm. In this role, you will turn complex data into actionable insights, develop data and reporting solutions, and help our commercial teams make smarter, data-driven decisions.



How you will make an impact  

As a Data & Insight Specialist at Arla, you will play a key role in strengthening data-driven decision-making across our commercial organization. You will combine analytical expertise, business understanding and a strong data product mindset to maximize the value of both internal and external data.

You will own and develop a portfolio of commercial data products and solutions and work closely with colleagues across Category Development, Sales and Marketing. An important part of the role is also managing external data providers and ensuring that the data and solutions we invest in create tangible value for the business.

In this role, you will

    Own and manage a portfolio of commercial data products, reporting solutions and analytical capabilities.
    Integrate and work with data from multiple internal and external sources to deliver reliable and actionable business insights.
    Develop and continuously improve dashboards, reporting solutions and analytical tools that support Customer Marketing and the broader commercial organization.
    Manage syndicated market and shopper data from external partners and ensure that data deliveries meet Arla’s business requirements and quality standards.
    Own relationships with key data suppliers, including budgets, contracts and commercial negotiations with partners such as NielsenIQ, ICA Self-Serve, Matpriskollen and other market data providers.
    Partner closely with Category Development, Sales, Marketing and other stakeholders to translate business needs and challenges into relevant analytical solutions.
    Turn data into meaningful category, shopper and commercial insights that support both strategic and operational decision-making.
    Conduct ad hoc analyses and provide data-driven recommendations on business opportunities, risks and performance.
    Continuously identify opportunities to improve and automate data processes, analytical capabilities and ways of working.



What will make you successful  

To succeed in this role, you bring a strong combination of analytical expertise, technical capability and commercial understanding, with the ability to turn complex data into actionable business insights.

We are looking for someone who has

    5+ years of relevant experience within business intelligence, analytics, data science or a related field.
    A relevant degree in Business, Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Data Science, Economics or equivalent practical experience.
    Strong SQL skills and experience working with large datasets, modern data platforms and both relational and NoSQL databases.
    Strong Power BI capabilities, with experience designing and developing intuitive dashboards and reports from concept to deployment.
    Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify trends, opportunities and business risks.
    Experience with data process automation, testing and data quality assurance.
    Experience working in cloud-based data and analytics environments.
    Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to build trust and influence decisions through data-driven recommendations.
    A solid understanding of commercial KPIs, category management, pricing and promotion metrics.
    Experience working effectively across functions and stakeholder groups.
    Strong communication skills in English. Swedish is an advantage



It would be an advantage if you also have

    Hands-on experience with Python, Spark/Hadoop, R or similar analytical and data engineering technologies.
    Experience applying AI, machine learning, predictive analytics or generative AI to business challenges.
    Experience from FMCG, retail or consumer goods.
    Experience working in an international environment.



Who are you?

    You are curious and commercially minded, with a strong interest in what drives business performance.
    You are proactive, take ownership and are comfortable driving work forward independently
    You build trust and strong relationships across functions and levels of the organization.
    You communicate complex insights clearly and use data to influence, challenge and support decision-making.
    You combine attention to detail with a broader business perspective and a continuous learning mindset.



Arla Foods has collective agreements, and we always ensure to offer good and competitive working conditions. In addition to that, safety and working environment are our top priorities, which is why we, among other things, conduct random drug and alcohol tests.

Would you like to join us?  



If you're passionate about turning data into insights and business value, we'd love to hear from you. Take this opportunity to join a team where your expertise can help shape decision-making and drive commercial success.



Apply as soon as possible, no later than 2026-09-15. Screening will take place on an ongoing basis during the application period. Please note that we are not able to process any applications sent by email, due to GDPR regulations. We welcome all applicants and strive for diversity in our recruitment processes.



If you have questions or would like more information about the position, please contact Hiring Manager Mikael Augustinson at miaug@arlafoods.com. If you have questions about the recruitment process, please contact Hannah Lagerstedt, Talent Acquisition Partner, hannah.lagerstedt@arlafoods.com.

Shape the Future of Dairy

Arla is a global leader in the dairy industry, committed to enabling good food choices that make life better, providing people with nourishment, while taking care at every step to ensure Arla is a choice they can feel good about. If you are looking to shape the future with an ambitious global cooperative that truly cares about your growth, where everyone feels valued and empowered, and collaboration is the core of culture, Arla is a choice you can feel good about

title: PhD Student in Robotics and Artificial Intelligence
description:
Are you ready to take the next step in your academic journey? As a doctoral student with us, you will work closely with leading researchers in a strong, international research environment, with access to advanced laboratory equipment and solid funding opportunities. You will be offered secure employment, high-quality supervision, and room to grow, both as a researcher and as a person.

https://www.ltu.se/research/subjects/RoboticsAI?l=en subject, RAI, at the Department of Computer Science and Electrical and Space Engineering at Luleå University of Technology, is now looking for a PhD student to contribute to our growing activities. The RAI team is conducting fundamental research in all the aspects of robotics with a specific focus on aerial, space and bioinspired robotics.



Subject description

Robotics and artificial intelligence aim to develop novel robotic systems that are characterized by advanced autonomy for improving the ability of robots to interact with the surrounding environment and humans during the execution of specific tasks.



Project description

The vision of RAI is aiming in closing the gap from theory to real life, while the team has a strong expertise in field robotics. Specific application areas of focus are long-term autonomous missions in large and uncertain environments, semantic mission planning with foundation models, agentic task decomposition and event-driven re-planning, and autonomous semantic-aware inspection of complex infrastructure. The RAI team has a strong European and National participation in multiple R&D&I projects.



Duties

As a PhD student you will perform research with substantial theoretical and experimental components that should be published in peer-reviewed major international journals and at major conferences. The position will include supervision of MSc and to assist in grant applications from research funding agencies/councils, the EU framework program or the industry. The position might also involve teaching assistance, seminars and presentations.

You will be working in the field of robotic autonomy, and all activities will be linked with National, European and worldwide R&D Projects.The research topic is in Robotics and Artificial Intelligence. More specifically, the position will involve dense research activities in designing, experimenting and theoretical development, with the following research areas providing a template for relevant directions.



Research Topics:

    Long-term Autonomy in Uncertain Environments
    a. Planning and Reasoning under Uncertainty
    - Decision-making under uncertainty
    - Decentralized planning and coordination for multi-agent systems
    b. Mapping and Scene Representations
    - Dynamic Scene Graphs modelling uncertainty
    - Unified situational awareness for multi-robot systems in large and degraded environments



Qualifications

To be qualified for the position, you must have an MSc degree in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related subject. Proficiency in C++, Python, and ROS 2 is required. Strong scientific skills with proven excellence in real-life experimentation, as well as very good communication skills, are considered a strong plus. You will represent the group on different occasions, both in Sweden and worldwide, so very good command of English is a must.



For further information about a specific subject see http://www.ltu.se/research/Utbildning-pa-forskarniva/Studieplaner/Allmanna-studieplaner-Teknisk-fakultetsnamnd?l=en



Further information

Employment as a PhD student is limited to 4 years, teaching and other department duties may be added with max 20%.

title: Doctoral Student
description:
Department of Aquatic Sciences and Assessment

Third-cycle subject area

Environmental assessment, specialising in environmental chemistry.

Description of the doctoral project





This doctoral project aims to improve the understanding of contaminants of emerging concern in soil matrices by using advanced chemical screening and source-oriented approaches as strategies for chemical prioritisation. The project will investigate the occurrence, distribution and transformation of contaminants in soils, and how these processes can be used to identify substances of relevance for terrestrial ecosystems and One Health. The project will focus on one or more selected soil systems, depending on sample availability, collaborations and scientific relevance.

The project includes i) selecting relevant soil systems, soil matrices and contaminants of emerging concern based on occurrence data, chemical properties, environmental persistence, mobility and available samples; ii) applying target, suspect and non-target screening using LC-HRMS to identify known and previously unknown substances in selected soil matrices; iii) assessing spatial patterns, persistence and transformation of contaminants where suitable data and samples are available; iv) using environmental specimen bank samples, where available, to investigate temporal trends and support retrospective screening; and v) connecting measured chemical patterns to possible environmental sources and processes governing contaminant distribution and fate.

You will work in an international, interdisciplinary team. The project provides access to advanced instrumentation and training in sample preparation, HRMS-based chemical analysis, data processing, statistical evaluation, scientific communication, and collaborative research.





About the position

We are seeking a PhD student who will advance the understanding of contaminants of emerging concern in soil matrices, with a particular focus on contaminant occurrence, persistence, transformation, mobility and advanced chemical screening. To achieve this aim, you will develop and apply analytical workflows for the detection and identification of known and previously unknown compounds in complex soil matrices, including sample preparation, extraction and clean-up strategies. The project will also include semi-quantitative analysis of detected compounds and the assessment of spatial and temporal patterns, persistence and transformation of contaminants in selected soil systems. Where suitable samples are available, environmental specimen bank material may be used to investigate time trends and support retrospective screening. The duties also include preparation of soil and environmental samples, extraction and analysis of target and non-target compounds, optimisation of analytical workflows, processing of large HRMS datasets, data analysis, statistical evaluation, interpretation of chemical patterns in relation to environmental sources and contaminant fate, collaboration with national and international partners, and scientific manuscript writing in English.

Requirements

To meet the general entry requirements you must have been awarded a second-cycle (Master’s) qualification, satisfied the requirements for courses comprising at least 240 credits of which at least 60 credits were awarded in the second-cycle, or acquired substantially equivalent knowledge in some other way in Sweden or abroad (Higher Education Ordinance 1993:100, Chapter 7, Section 39).

Specific entry requirements for the third-cycle courses and study programme in Environmental assessment, specialising in environmental chemistry. To meet the specific entry requirements, you must have knowledge of aquatic ecology, aquatic biogeochemistry, statistics or ecotoxicology.

You must also meet the equivalent English language requirements as those necessary for the Swedish upper-secondary qualification Engelska B/6.

Your profile

Applicants shall hold an MSc in analytical chemistry, environmental chemistry, chemistry, environmental science, soil science, geoscience or equivalent. Specialisation in chemical analysis of organic contaminants and experience with LC-MS/MS, LC-HRMS or other advanced mass spectrometry techniques are valuable merits. Experience with suspect and non-target screening workflows is highly desirable. Previous experience with chemical analytical laboratory work, particularly involving complex environmental matrices such as soil, sediment, sludge, compost or other solid environmental samples, is advantageous.

Knowledge of contaminants of emerging concern, their environmental fate, persistence, transformation, mobility, sorption or transport in soil systems is considered a merit. Experience with source apportionment, spatial or temporal trend analysis, retrospective screening or environmental specimen bank samples is also considered an advantage. Data processing skills using statistical computing, visualisation and data analysis tools (e.g. R, Python or similar) are also considered a merit. Emphasis is also placed on personal characteristics such as strong interpersonal skills, analytical and problem-solving abilities, accuracy, motivation, and the capacity to work independently as well as in collaboration with others.
