title: Senior Mechanical Design Lead - Data Center EPC
description:
Senior Design Manager – Mechanical at Five Nines Sweden AB

Five Nines is an EPC (Engineering, Procurement & Construction) firm delivering mission-critical data center projects. We're looking for an experienced Senior Design Manager – Mechanical to lead mechanical (including piping and plumbing) design delivery across our data center projects.

Reporting to the Head of Design, you will act as the technical authority and single point of accountability for mechanical and plumbing design on assigned projects, directing and quality-controlling the work of external engineering consultants and ensuring designs are delivered on time, on budget and to the technical, safety and operational standards our mission-critical facilities demand.

What you will do:

    Direct, brief, and manage external mechanical consultants from concept through to issued-for-construction and as-built documentation, holding them accountable for scope, fee, quality and schedule.
    Review and challenge consultant deliverables, such as but not limited to calculations, schematics, drawings, specifications, and equipment schedules before every issue.
    Provide senior technical oversight of HVAC and cooling system design for data centers, including CRAH/CRAC units, chilled water systems, chillers, free/adiabatic cooling, and airflow management.
    Oversee plumbing, drainage, and fire protection design, including special hazard suppression systems typical of data center white space.
    Ensure designs comply with ASHRAE, local codes, and Uptime Institute Tier requirements, supporting N, N+1, and 2N resiliency targets.
    Act as mechanical/plumbing lead within the multi-discipline design team, resolving clashes through structured, BIM-based coordination reviews.
    Serve as the primary mechanical/plumbing point of contact for clients, authorities, third-party reviewers, and commissioning agents.

What you bring:

    Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Building Services Engineering, or a related discipline.
    10+ years of relevant design/engineering experience, ideally in mission-critical, data center, or complex industrial facilities.
    Proven experience managing or directing external design consultants within an EPC, design-build or major capital projects environment.
    Strong working knowledge of BIM-based design coordination in Revit and associated platforms.
    Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and consultant teams in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
    Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills, with sound commercial awareness and a rigorous approach to design quality assurance.
    Fluent in English is a requirement, Swedish speaking is a plus but not necessary

What we offer:

    The opportunity to shape mechanical and plumbing design delivery on complex and mission-critical data center projects.
    A senior, high-visibility role with direct influence over technical quality, programme and consultant performance.
    A collaborative, multi-discipline engineering environment within a growing EPC organization.
    A competitive salary and benefits package, commensurate with experience.

Five Nines is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of background.

title: Senior Research Scientist - Peptide Analysis & Analytical Development
description:
We are seeking a Senior Research Scientist in analytical chemistry to join our Pharmaceutical Research & Early Development team in Lund. In this role, you will play a key part in our CMC activities, applying advanced analytical methods that underpin the characterization, stability, and regulatory approval of peptide drug substances and formulations.

You will apply advanced analytical expertise to characterize complex peptide molecules and their formulated products, including those based on Camurus’ proprietary FluidCrystal® lipid-based delivery technology. This is a unique opportunity to contribute to the development of next-generation therapies that have a direct impact on clinical-stage programs.

The Role
Analytical Method Development & Characterization

    

Develop, optimize, and apply analytical methods based on a range of separation and detection techniques — including LC-MS/MS, SEC-UV, HPLC-UV/DAD, 2D-LC-MS for the characterization of peptide drug substances and complex drug products, such as lipid-based systems.

    

Develop and oversee the use of complementary physicochemical techniques (e.g. CD Spectroscopy, DLS, NMR) to support higher-order structural characterization and aggregation assessment of peptides.

Degradation & Impurity Profiling

    

Design and execute stability and forced degradation studies to systematically identify degradation pathways (hydrolysis, oxidation, deamidation, racemisation, aggregation) under long-term storage and stress conditions.

    

Characterize and structurally elucidate degradation products and process-related impurities using mass spectrometry and other orthogonal methods.

    

Build and maintain comprehensive impurity profile knowledge for peptide APIs and formulated products in support of ICH Q3A/Q3B and Q6B specifications.

Stability Studies

    

Set up, manage, and provide scientific conclusions and recommendations based on stability data (from real-time, accelerated, and stress studies) for peptide drug substances and formulations, to guide formulation development and define shelf-life.

    

Identify and investigate stability-indicating attributes and develop stability-indicating analytical methods.

CMC & Regulatory Support

    

Author and critically review analytical sections of CMC regulatory dossiers for IND/CTA and NDA/MAA submissions.

    

Respond to regulatory agency questions on analytical matters and support pre-submission meetings where relevant.

Collaboration & Scientific Leadership

    

Collaborate cross-functionally with formulation scientists, pharmaceutical development, quality assurance, and manufacturing colleagues in project teams.

    

Act as the analytical science expert for assigned drug development projects, contributing to strategic decisions on characterization and testing approaches.

    

Keep up to date with advances in peptide analytical science, regulatory expectations, and industry best practices.

Your Profile
We are looking for a detail-oriented, scientifically driven analyst who delivers high-quality data. You confidently lead analytical investigations, communicate findings clearly, and translate complex results into actionable insights. You take ownership of your work and are motivated to advance novel peptide therapies to patients.

This role requires:

    

Ph.D. in analytical chemistry, pharmaceutical chemistry, medicinal chemistry, or a closely related discipline.

    

Minimum 5 years of post-doctoral or industrial experience in analytical development, with a focus on peptides or biopharmaceuticals.

    

Advanced hands-on expertise in chromatographic and hyphenated techniques for peptide analysis: RP-HPLC/UHPLC, LC-MS/MS, and HPLC-UV/DAD, including method development and validation.

    

Demonstrated experience analyzing peptides in complex or non-aqueous formulation matrices (e.g. lipid-based, semi-solid, or depot systems).

    

Strong understanding of peptide degradation chemistry and proven experience designing and interpreting forced degradation and impurity profiling studies.

    

Experience setting up and interpreting stability studies in accordance with ICH Q1A–Q1F guidelines.

    

Track record of contributing to CMC analytical sections of regulatory dossiers (IND/CTA or NDA/MAA), with solid working knowledge of relevant ICH guidelines.

    

Experience working in structured, cross-functional project teams with demonstrated ability to deliver results independently.

It is advantageous if you also have any of the following:

    

Experience with structural characterization of peptides in complex matrices by e.g. high-resolution mass spectrometry.

    

Familiarity with complementary biophysical techniques: CD spectroscopy, DLS, SEC-MALS, or solid-state characterization methods.

    

Experience with analytical method transfer to QC laboratories or CMOs.

    

Exposure to GMP analytical environments.

    

Familiarity with statistical tools for analytical data treatment and data integrity principles (21 CFR Part 11 / EU Annex 11).

What We Offer
This is a great time to join a highly dynamic company during a very exciting phase of growth. The position offers an international work environment and corporate culture, with the possibility for individual development and growth. The corporate culture is driven by our core values of innovation, collaboration, ownership, quality, and passion for realizing our patient-centric commitment.

Application
This is an immediate, full-time employment opportunity. The selection process is ongoing, so submit your application as soon as possible, and no later than 15 September. Please attach your CV and a cover letter describing your motivation and the expertise you bring to this role. Please note that we do not accept applications by e-mail.

Read more about how Camurus will process your personal data here.

We are looking forward to seeing your application!

title: Deputy Category Manager
description:
Company Description

At IKEA, we want to create a better everyday life for the many people. To do that, we need strong supply chain and logistics solutions that help us move products safely, efficiently and sustainably across the world.

We are now looking for a Deputy Category Manager to join Category Food Logistics Services.



In this role, you will play an important part in developing and managing logistics service solutions that support the IKEA Food business globally. You will work closely with colleagues across the IKEA value chain and with external logistics service providers to secure business performance, develop long-term partnerships and help us meet future business needs. The role combines business development, procurement, category management, stakeholder management and people leadership.



About the role

As Deputy Category Manager, you will contribute to the development and execution of category and sourcing strategies that support the long-term direction of IKEA Food logistics services. You will lead procurement activities, support service provider development and drive performance across cost, service, sustainability, quality, safety and security dimensions.

You will work in a global environment with many stakeholders and play an active role in developing the business, improving ways of working and supporting the growth and development of co-workers.

Your responsibilities

    Develop and implement sourcing and category strategies for Food Logistics Services.
    Lead procurement and negotiation activities and secure implementation of agreed business results.
    Drive business performance across cost, service, sustainability, quality, safety and security.
    Build, manage and develop long-term partnerships with logistics service providers and other external business partners.
    Analyse market developments, industry trends and business opportunities to support fact-based decision making.
    Lead and develop co-workers through coaching, feedback and competence development.
    Collaborate with stakeholders across Supply Chain Operations, IKEA Food and other parts of IKEA.
    Contribute to strategic projects and continuous improvement initiatives.
    Act as a role model for IKEA culture, values and leadership.

Who you are

You are a strong leader and business professional who enjoys working in a global and changing environment. You build trust quickly, create engagement around common goals and feel comfortable balancing strategic priorities with operational business needs.

You are motivated by developing people, building partnerships and finding new opportunities that create value for the business and for our customers. You lead through collaboration, curiosity and a strong belief in the IKEA values.



To be successful in this role, you have

Required qualifications

    University degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, Economics, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
    Minimum 10 years of experience in a strategic logistics, procurement, category management or supply chain leadership role within IKEA, Inter IKEA Group, Ingka Group or another IKEA organisation.
    Extensive experience working within the IKEA value chain and a strong understanding of how different IKEA functions interact to deliver business results.
    Proven experience leading strategic sourcing, procurement or category management activities within IKEA.
    Experience leading, developing and coaching people and teams.
    Experience managing relationships with food logistics service providers, suppliers and external partners.
    Strong knowledge of the IKEA strategic landscape, business model, governance framework, culture and values.

title: Instrument Associate
description:
The European Spallation Source (ESS) is one of the largest science and technology infrastructure projects being built today. ESS will soon be the world’s most powerful source of neutrons, providing researchers with unique opportunities to explore the structure of materials at the atomic level. Neutron scattering at ESS will address critical questions in physics, chemistry, geology, materials science and life science.

We are now looking for an Instrument Associate for the DREAM instrument. All the physical installations at the instrument are completed, and the team is getting ready for the hot commissioning with neutrons. The position is with the Diffraction & Imaging Division.  



About the division

The Diffraction & Imaging Division consists of the scientific staff that is leading the instrument construction projects and the staff that will eventually execute the day-to-day operations of six neutron instruments. The upcoming responsibilities of the division are

    Finalize the installation and commissioning of all instruments in the division
    Deliver state-of-the-art scientific capabilities for internal and external users to enable the wider science community to advance science and technology
    Deliver scientific results from the neutron instruments in collaboration with the user community and other divisions in the science directorate
    Plan and implement further developments and upgrades of the instruments
    Push the state-of-the-art capabilities of neutron instrumentation to make maximum benefit from the ESS source.  



Responsibilities

    Join a team of scientists, engineers, and technicians aiming to prepare a neutron instrument for first user operation and beyond
    Collaborate closely with Instrument Associates, engineers, and technicians in specialist disciplines at ESS
    Support the instrument scientists by preparing safety documentation, including standard operating procedures and operations manuals for an instrument.
    Support the instrument scientists in preparing, executing and documenting testing of an instrument with neutrons (“hot commissioning”)
    Plan, manage and/or execute scheduled and unscheduled maintenance of the instrument
    Act as the system owner for an instrument, keeping the maintenance records and engineering documentation up to date with changes.
    Coordination with specialized technology groups (Choppers, Detectors, Motion Control, etc.) and support teams (vacuum, rigging, survey and alignment)
    Working with operational groups (Hall Coordinators, ESH, Control Room Operators)
    Support user experiments on the instrument by e.g. building mechanical and/or electrical support systems in the in-house workshop, and helping to set up sample environments, which includes:
    Writing and Review of Experiment Hazard Analyses
    Providing assistance in sample mounting
    Setting up instrument configurations
    Assisting in user experiments, including training users on instrument operations



Required skills & experience

We are looking for a self-motivated person who is keen to support an instrument team in order to get it ready for the first neutrons. You should be a ‘hands-on’ person and open to learning new things along the way. We attach great importance to personality and attitude, so we're looking for a real team player: Someone who is sociable, has excellent communication skills, and who likes to collaborate with different people. You will have:  

    A bachelor’s or master’s degree in the Sciences
    Proven experience, supported by reference letters, of being an effective team member, facilitating cross-department interactions with scientists, engineers, technicians, and operational support groups, as well as external collaborators and users
    Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to be able to interact effectively with a diverse group of scientists, engineers, and technical staff, including experience of communicating technical information clearly in both written and verbal form, documenting procedures, creating maintenance documentation, test reports, or safety-related documentation
    Experience in testing, supporting, maintaining, and operating complex technical equipment in large-scale user facilities
    Experience with experiments and user support at large-scale user facilities
    Excellent oral and written English skills

Physical requirements for this job include the use of hand, eye and ear protection gear, stooping, kneeling, lifting, and sitting or standing for extended periods of time.



Desirable skills:

    Experience in programming (python, Matlab, C++ or similar)
    Experience working in an international research environment
    Practical experience in operating complex sample environments relating to powder diffraction and imaging



Duration & Location

The position is a 3 year fixed term role and the workplace will be situated in Lund, Sweden. Travelling is expected if the need arises.



Application & Contact

A career at ESS gives you the opportunity to contribute to the future discoveries within neutron science at a stunning, brand-new workplace filled with innovative minds and brilliant people from across the globe. We offer market competitive, individualised compensation which is differentiated according to role, responsibilities, individual skills, abilities and achievements as well as monthly pension contributions on top of your salary.  

If you see yourself in what we’re looking for, please provide your CV and motivation letter in English by clicking on “apply” and following the instructions. Please be aware that we can only accept direct applications made via the ESS website. Submit your application as soon as you can, no later than X.  

This role requires additional security screening processes, which will be performed during the recruitment or onboarding process.  

For further information regarding the position, please contact Talent Acquisition Specialist Louise Jönegård on louise.jonegardmailto:email@ess.eu or Hiring Manager Mikhail Feygenson on mailto:mikhail.feygenson@ess.eu.    

For trade union information, please contact Unionen representative Nuno Elias on mailto:nuno.elias@ess.eu or SACO/Swedish Association of Graduate Engineers representative Marc Kickulies at mailto:marc.kickulies@ess.eu   

We look forward to receiving your applications soon!

title: Park- och gatuchef
description:
Omgivet av hav i tre väderstreck, med vacker natur och goda kommunikationer är Båstads kommun en modern idyll med fullskalig service. Vårt strategiska läge på Bjärehalvön med två järnvägsstationer, närhet till flygplats och motorväg gör oss dessutom till en attraktiv pendlingskommun och kreativ mötesplats för olika människor, erfarenheter och kompetenser.

Vår vision är att vara en förebild för ett friskt liv och hållbart entreprenörskap samt att attrahera människor som vill värna det sunda livet och utveckla kunskap, kultur och affärer. Båstads kommun är en attraktiv och utvecklande arbetsplats där vår värdegrund bygger på professionalism, arbetsglädje och respekt.

Tillsammans gör vi skillnad varje dag genom att ge god service till våra invånare, med engagemang, samarbete och vilja att utvecklas.

Nu söker vi dig som har förmåga att se helheten och som identifierar sig som en tydlig, strukturerad och serviceinriktad park- och gatuchef. Du kommer ingå inom verksamhetsområdet Teknik och Service  tillsammans med ca 130 kollegor som utför uppdrag inom bygg- och anläggningsprojekt, mark/exploatering, fastighet, park/gata, kultur/fritid och måltid/lokalvård.

1 plats(er).

ARBETSUPPGIFTER
Som park- och gatuchef kommer du att ansvara för avdelningens ledning, ekonomi, planering och utveckling av avdelningens park-, gator- och naturvårdsverksamhet. Du ingår i verksamhetsområdets ledningsgrupp och rapporterar till verksamhetschefen för Teknik och service.

Verksamheten består huvudsakligen av drift- och underhåll av parker, grönytor, lekplatser, gator, gång- och cykelvägar och skogs- och naturvård.

Du har en viktig roll i att bidra till park- och gatuavdelningens strategiska utveckling och skapa långsiktigt värde och upplevelse av kommunens allmänna platser, parker och gator.

Uppdraget bygger på att du aktivt leder och utvecklar verksamheten så att de strategiska målen uppnås på ett kostnadseffektivt sätt med överenskommen kvalitét och nöjdhet av verksamheten.

Rollen som park- och gatuchef innebär också att du skapar goda förutsättningar för medarbetarnas utveckling och säkerställer att avdelningen har fungerande processer och tillräckligt systemstöd. Som ledare har du en viktig uppgift att tydliggöra mål, ansvar och roller.

Huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter:

    • Leda och utveckla park- och gatuavdelningen och säkerställa att kommunens allmänna platser, parker och gator skötsel och underhåll utförs långsiktigt.
    • Ansvarig för park- och gatuavdelningens budget och ekonomisk uppföljning.
    • Utveckla park- och gatuverksamheten och säkerställa struktur, kostnadseffektivitet och god kommunikation.
    • Identifiera synergier och effektivisering genom samarbete inom kommunkoncernen.

KVALIFIKATIONER
Vi söker dig med framtidsvisioner och ett tydligt, närvarande och framåtsträvande ledarskap och har en god förmåga till samarbete.

Du har högskoleutbildning som civilingenjör eller ingenjör alternativt annan relevant utbildning kombinerat med yrkeserfarenhet som arbetsgivaren bedömer likvärdig. Du har erfarenhet av att vara chef eller projektledare inom anläggnings-, park- eller gatuverksamhet.

Du är lyhörd, kreativ, kvalitetsmedveten och har lätt för att skapa och utveckla relationer genom god kommunikationsförmåga. Du arbetar proaktivt, initiativtagande och är framåtlutad och modig i ditt ledarskap.

Erfarenhet krävs och B-körkort är ett krav.

Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning.
Varaktighet: Tillsvidare, tillträde: 2027-01-01  Eller enligt överenskommelse.

Vi erbjuder friskvårdsbidrag och möjlighet till både löne- och semesterlöneväxling enligt gällande avtal. Rökfri arbetstid tillämpas. Som del av Familjen Helsingborg samarbetar vi med andra kommuner i regionen för kompetensutveckling och erfarenhetsutbyte.

Kommunala avtal gäller, och vid tillsvidareanställning ingår en skyldighet till krigsplacering i Båstads kommun. Vi värdesätter mångfald och välkomnar alla sökande hos oss är det viktigt att varje medarbetares kompetens tas tillvara.

Fackliga representanter nås via respektive förbunds webbplats.

Vi tillämpar löpande urval - Välkommen med din ansökan!

Båstads kommun har tagit ställning till rekryteringskanaler och undanber sig därför kontakt med mediesäljare, rekryteringssajter och liknande.

title: Customer Technical Support Manager
description:
Erasteel is a global leader in high-speed steels, powder metallurgy steels, and specialty alloys. We serve demanding industries such as automotive, aerospace, tooling, and manufacturing, where innovation, quality, and technical expertise are at the heart of everything we do.

Join Erasteel and shape the future of high-performance materials

We are now looking for a Customer Technical Support Manager to our Technical Customer Support team. This is an exciting opportunity for a technically skilled and customer-focused professional who enjoys working at the interface between customers, sales, production, quality, and R&D.

About the role

As Customer Technical Support Manager, you will be responsible for providing technical expertise and support to customers within the cold work and specialties segment. You will play a key role in developing customer relationships, identifying new business opportunities, and driving technical development initiatives together with internal stakeholders.

You will work closely with Sales, Production, Quality, and R&D teams to ensure customer satisfaction and support the continued growth of Erasteel's product portfolio.

Key Responsibilities

    Lead technical support activities for customers in the specialties market segment.
    Provide technical support for loose powder applications.
    Act as the primary technical contact for customers and support the sales team with technical expertise.
    Serve as the link between customers and internal functions, including Production and Quality.
    Drive development of new products, applications, and technical solutions based on customer needs.
    Follow customer trials and support successful implementation and commercialization.
    Analyze market trends within the PM industry and propose new development opportunities.
    Participate in benchmarking activities and competitor analysis to support innovation.
    Contribute to product promotion by developing and reviewing technical documentation, including datasheets, brochures, presentations, and user guides.
    Organize and deliver customer training sessions on PM materials, heat treatment, material properties, and related technical topics.
    Review, implement, and communicate customer specifications across the organization.

About You

We are looking for a technically driven professional who combines strong engineering knowledge with excellent communication and relationship-building skills.

Qualifications

    Master's degree (or equivalent) in Metallurgy, Materials Science, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field.
    Minimum 2-5 years of experience within manufacturing, tooling, machining, process engineering, applications engineering, or related industrial environments.
    Solid understanding of:
    Stamping and punching processes
    Plastic injection molding parameters
    Tool wear and tool life optimization
    Powder Metallurgy High Speed Steels (PM-HSS)
    Mechanical and corrosion resistance properties
    Fatigue resistance and material performance

Personal Qualities

    Strong customer focus and service mindset.
    Clear and effective communicator.
    Analytical and solution-oriented approach.
    Ability to build relationships across cultures and functions.
    Self-driven with a proactive attitude.
    Comfortable working in an international environment.

Why Join Erasteel?

At Erasteel, you will become part of an international company recognized for its expertise in specialty steels and advanced materials. You will have the opportunity to work with leading industrial customers, contribute to innovation projects, and play a key role in developing solutions for tomorrow's manufacturing challenges.

Location: Söderfors, Sweden

Reporting to: Technical Director

Interested?

We look forward to receiving your application and learning more about how your expertise can contribute to Erasteel's continued success.

Om arbetsgivaren - Erasteel

Erasteel är en global koncern som bedriver forskning & utveckling samt produktion och försäljning av gasatomiserade pulvermetallurgiska produkter och snabbstål med världen som marknad. Erasteel har flera hundra anställda och 5 industrianläggningar, varav 2 i Sverige, 2 i Frankrike och 1 i Kina. Bolaget är kvalitets- och miljöcertifierat.

För mer information om bolaget, besök www.erasteel.com

title: Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH Akutspital 80-100% für die Region Wetzikon gesucht
description:
- Für ein bekanntes Haus im Bereich Pflege und Medizin in der Region Wetzikon suchen wir Sie als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH – Schwerpunkt Akutspital.

### Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH in Wetzikon: das Wichtigste in Kürze

**Position:** Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH

**Fachbereich:** Akutspital

**Pensum:** 80–100 %

**Anstellung:** Feste Stelle

**Start:** Nach Vereinbarung

**Arbeitsort:** Region Wetzikon

**Arbeitgeber:** Den Namen nennen wir Ihnen gerne im Gespräch

Kurz gesagt: Der Rahmen stimmt. Zudem lernen Sie nun den Arbeitsort besser kennen, denn genau darum geht es als Nächstes.
Wetzikon liegt im Zürcher Oberland und besticht durch eine hervorragende Verkehrsanbindung via Bahn und Autobahn. Die dynamische Stadt bietet Ihnen ein breites Spektrum an Arbeitsplätzen in Industrie, Handel und Dienstleistungen. Die attraktive Lage zwischen Zürich und dem Appenzellland, kombiniert mit guter Infrastruktur und hoher Lebensqualität, macht Wetzikon zu einem wertvollen Arbeitsort für Pendler und Ortsansässige.

### So sieht Ihr Alltag als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Akutspital in Wetzikon aus

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung

- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente

- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert

- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an

- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System

- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

### Was Sie für diese Stelle mitbringen

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH

- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich

- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha

- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art

- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Akutspital

Sie arbeiten im Akutbereich eines Spitals: Patientinnen und Patienten kommen, genesen und gehen – der Rhythmus ist dynamisch. Dabei erleben Sie die ganze Bandbreite der Medizin, arbeiten interdisziplinär und entwickeln Ihre Fachkompetenz laufend weiter.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Akutspital in Wetzikon verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Genau solche Stellen vermitteln wir am liebsten.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Als diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH tragen Sie die fachliche Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Damit sichern Sie Tag für Tag die Qualität der Pflege.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.
Der Arbeitsmarkt für diplomierte Pflegefachpersonen in der Region Wetzikon zeigt eine anhaltend hohe Nachfrage, insbesondere in Akutspitälern mit flexiblen Pensenmodellen zwischen 80 und 100 Prozent. Sie profitieren von ausgezeichneten Karrierechancen, attraktiven Löhnen und modernen Arbeitsbedingungen. iPersonal unterstützt Sie als erfahrener Vermittler mit persönlicher Beratung, gezielter Jobvermittlung und kontinuierlicher Betreuung, um Ihnen den Einstieg in eine passende Stelle unkompliziert zu gestalten.

### Ihre Vorteile mit MediPersonal in der Region Wetzikon

- Kostenlose Weiterbildungen über [Temptraining](https://temptraining.ch) – somit bekommt Ihre Karriere Rückenwind

- Persönliche Begleitung von der Bewerbung bis zum ersten Arbeitstag

- Dazu schnelle sowie ehrliche Antworten – meist innerhalb von 24 Stunden

- Faire Verträge nach GAV, denn Ihr Lohn soll klar und offen sein

- Zudem eine langfristige Perspektive, denn wir vermitteln Stellen, die wirklich zu Ihrem Leben passen

- Und vor allem: Diskretion garantiert – Ihre Bewerbung behandeln wir streng vertraulich

### Häufige Fragen zur Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Akutspital in Wetzikon

**Welche Ausbildung brauche ich für diese Stelle?**
Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

**Ist mein ausländisches Pflegediplom in der Schweiz gültig?**
Ja, sofern das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK) Ihr Diplom anerkannt hat. Ausserdem beraten wir Sie gerne kostenlos zur Anerkennung.

**Wie schnell erhalte ich eine Rückmeldung auf meine Bewerbung?**
In der Regel melden wir uns bereits innerhalb von 24 Stunden bei Ihnen, denn Ihre Zeit ist wertvoll. Zudem halten wir Sie danach laufend auf dem neusten Stand.

**Erfahre ich den Namen des Arbeitgebers?**
Ja – sobald wir sprechen, nennen wir Ihnen den Namen der Institution offen. Denn Offenheit gehört bei uns dazu.

title: Sr. Project Manager Construction Pharma Environment
description:
Sr. Project Manager Construction Pharma Environment  
At Johnson \& Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at .  
As guided by Our Credo, Johnson \& Johnson is responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson \& Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit.  
Cilag AG in Schaffhausen, Switzerland is part of the Johnson \& Johnson Innovative Medicine (J\&J IM) Supply Chain organization and is currently recruiting for a  
Senior Project Manager Construction Pharma  
The Senior Project Manager serves as a senior technical leader on capital projects, ensuring alignment to J\&J standards and regulatory requirements. This role leads large capital projects, partnering with Quality, EHS, Operations, and external A\&E/CM firms.  
Key Responsibilities  
Strategic Project Leadership \& Delivery  
Lead large capital projects across all project phases (planning, design, procurement, construction, commissioning).  
Coordinate multi\-functional engineering strategies to meet schedule, budget, quality, and regulatory requirements.  
Technical Authority \& Governance  
Act as the senior technical authority, review and approve engineering design changes, and technical submittals.  
Ensure engineering solutions align with J\&J standards, industry codes, and regulatory expectations.  
Budget \& Cost Management  
Lead multi‑million‑dollar capital budgets for assigned projects, monitor costs, and support procurement and contractor selection and evaluation.  
Participate in contractor bid reviews and support value\-engineering decisions.  
Scheduling, Risk \& Performance Management  
Lead schedule development and integration with program timelines; identify critical path items and drive mitigation.  
Maintain a proactive risk register, recommend mitigations, and track performance metrics.  
Construction Management \& Field Leadership  
Provide senior owner\-side engineering oversight during construction and commissioning; ensure contractor performance aligns with design intent and J\&J EHS standards.  
Promote a strong safety culture and ensure EHS compliance on site.  
Documentation \& Reporting  
Maintain detailed engineering records, design documentation, and as\-built information.  
Prepare and present executive\-level status updates, technical summaries, and risk briefings.  
Education \& Experience  
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Architecture, or Construction Management required; Master’s degree preferred.  
10\+ years of experience leading capital projects, preferably in regulated industries (pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, or similar).  
Demonstrated owner\-side engineering leadership and experience working with A\&E and Construction Management firms.  
Experience leading multi\-discipline teams and collaborating with quality, EHS, operations, and external consultants.  
Skills \& Competencies  
Strong technical judgment and problem\-solving skills.  
Excellent communication and leadership skills for multi\-functional and executive interactions.  
Proven track record to lead budgets, schedules, and complex contractor relationships.  
Familiarity with regulatory expectations for facilities in regulated industries.  
Proficiency with project management and engineering documentation tools.  
Additional Requirements  
Location of Role: Primary Location: Schaffhausen, Switzerland  
Language Requirements: Proficiency: English \& German

description:
Sr. Supervisor QA Complaint Approval  
At Johnson \& Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at .  
As guided by Our Credo, Johnson \& Johnson is responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson \& Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit.  
Cilag AG in Schaffhausen belongs to the group of Johnson \& Johnson Innovative Medicine and manufactures high quality pharmaceutical products, active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) and medical devices. Today Cilag AG is one of the largest pharmaceutical manufacturers in Switzerland supplying all the major global markets. The Schaffhausen facility is a strategic launch and growth site for parenteral products, and we have an impressive pipeline of new and innovative products.  
The Senior Supervisor, Complaint Quality Approver Team is accountable for leading a team of Complaint Quality Approvers responsible for independent, objective review and approval of complaint records. The role provides people leadership, operational oversight, and quality decision support to ensure complaint investigations are complete, scientifically justified, risk\-based, and compliant with applicable procedures and regulations. The Senior Supervisor ensures consistent approval practices, timely record progression, appropriate escalation of quality risks, and continuous capability development across the team.  
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES  
The Senior Supervisor leads the Complaint Quality Approver team and is responsible for assigning, prioritizing, and monitoring work to ensure compliant and timely approval of complaint records. The role provides guidance to approvers on investigation strategy, risk assessment, escalation, evidence requirements, Root Cause Analysis, NC considerations, and alignment of investigation conclusions across products or affiliates when applicable. The Senior Supervisor ensures that approval decisions are made consistently and are supported by objective evidence, applicable procedures, and current regulatory expectations. In addition, the role reviews complex or high\-risk complaint records, supports escalation to Quality leadership, and drives alignment with cross\-functional partners when investigation direction, closure readiness, or quality risk requires leadership input.  
The Senior Supervisor is accountable for developing team capability through coaching, feedback, training, and performance management. The role establishes clear expectations for documentation quality, approval rationale, system usage, and stakeholder communication, and ensures the team applies best practices consistently. The Senior Supervisor monitors workload, cycle time, quality metrics, backlog, and recurring investigation trends to identify improvement opportunities, remove barriers, and support sustainable business continuity. The role also contributes to process improvement initiatives, inspection readiness, audit support, and the implementation of global or site quality system changes impacting complaint record approval.  
KEY INTERFACES  
Complaint Quality Approvers to provide leadership, coaching, work prioritization, and performance feedback.  
Complaint investigation owners and cross\-functional contributors, including Manufacturing, QC, Engineering, Supply Chain, Packaging, MSAT, Regulatory, and Medical Safety as applicable.  
Quality leadership for escalation, risk communication, resource planning, operational performance, and decision alignment.  
Other sites and affiliates to align investigation strategy, closure expectations, evidence requirements, and consistent complaint outcomes for site\-manufactured products.  
Audit, inspection readiness, quality systems, and process improvement stakeholders to support compliant execution and continuous improvement.  
REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE \& SKILLS  
Strong knowledge of quality investigations, complaint handling, CAPA and nonconformance concepts in a regulated pharmaceutical or medical product environment.  
Demonstrated ability to lead, coach, and develop a team in a quality organization, including setting priorities and managing performance.  
Strong understanding of cGMP, Good Documentation Practices, data integrity expectations, and applicable U.S. and international regulatory requirements.  
Proven ability to assess complex technical data, investigation conclusions, risk assessments, and escalation needs.  
Ability to make sound quality decisions, communicate clear rationale, and ensure consistency in approval standards.  
Strong stakeholder management skills and ability to operate effectively in a matrixed, cross\-functional, and global environment.  
Ability to drive sustainable process improvements.  
Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to provide actionable feedback and represent the team in leadership discussions.  
Strong organization, prioritization, and decision\-making skills to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and escalations.  
EDUCATION \& EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS  
Master’s degree or PhD in Life Science or related discipline, or equivalent experience, is required.  
Minimum of 3\-4 years of experience in quality investigations, complaint handling, quality systems, or a related regulated quality environment is required.  
Prior people leadership, team lead, supervisory, or demonstrated coaching experience is strongly preferred.  
Experience performing, reviewing, approving, or providing oversight for complex quality investigations, complaints, deviations, nonconformances, or similar quality events.  
Experience working with cross\-functional stakeholders and quality leadership to manage risk, escalation, and decision alignment.  
Demonstrated ability to drive process improvement, inspection readiness, and consistent execution of quality system requirements.  
Proven critical thinking, problem\-solving, communication, and people leadership skills.

Security & Identity

Cloud Security

Data Security & Compliance

AI & Security Innovation

- Take ownership of solutions beyond the prototype stage, including testing, deployment, monitoring, documentation, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement.
- Maintain and further develop existing automation and AI solutions across the organization.

title: Natural Hazards Mission Lead
description:
ETH Zurich is establishing the ETH Swiss GeoLab, a new interdisciplinary unit of ETH Zürich I Space. ETH Space will soon become one of few strategic centres of ETH Zurich, and encompasses overall five units.

The GeoLab is focused on Earth observation and its applications. The GeoLab uses satellite, airborne, ground-based and in-situ observations. To these diverse data sets it applies AI-driven analysis methods and high-performance computing to develop solutions for specific societal and economic challenges.

Located at the D4 Business Village in Root, close to Lucerne, ETH Swiss GeoLab works at the interface of research, technology development and practical application. In its first phase, the GeoLab is focusing on few selected high-impact application areas where Earth observation, geodata and AI-based analytics can create tangible value for Switzerland. The Natural Hazards Mission focuses initially on mass movements, including landslides and rockfalls, with the aim of improving early detection, monitoring, preparedness and decision support for Swiss practitioners, authorities and infrastructure stakeholders. It builds on stakeholder engagement, solution scoping and community-building activities already underway within GeoLab, including contributions from senior domain experts and partners in the Swiss natural hazards community.

The ETH Swiss GeoLab is led by Prof. Dr Verena Griess and Prof. Dr Thomas Zurbuchen, with Dr Felix Seidel as Managing Director, responsible for the day-to-day operations of this exciting activity. The GeoLab will grow into a project-based hub of around 100 experts over the coming years and will collaborate closely with other ETH units, the Swiss National Supercomputing Centre (CSCS), Swiss research institutions, public-sector stakeholders, natural hazard organisations, industry partners, start-ups and international stakeholders.

This position is offered as a fixed-term appointment for an initial period of two years, with the possibility of extension.

As Natural Hazards Mission Lead, you will lead the research and development portfolio, integration and delivery of GeoLab’s Natural Hazards Mission. Initially focused on landslides and rockfalls, and later expanding to other natural hazards, you will help define the mission vision, translate user needs into research and product requirements, and ensure that GeoLab activities create measurable value for Swiss practice and public decision-making. You will build on ongoing interchange with key stakeholders and solution-scoping activities already underway within GeoLab, and work closely with senior domain-relevant partners, technical teams and experts.

You will report to the Managing Director of ETH Swiss GeoLab and work closely with GeoLab’s Natural Hazards Community & Solutions Lead, other GeoLab mission teams, the Research Program Support team, and the Geo-Intelligence team and external partners. You will define priorities, milestones and decision points, lead mission delivery and will have the authority to prioritize, redirect, and pivot or pause activities within your research and development portfolio, the approved mission charter, budget and governance framework.

As part of your role, you will:

On behalf of the GeoLab leadership team, define an ambitious and coherent research and development portfolio for the Natural Hazards Mission, initially centred on landslides and rockfalls
Translate identified critical operational gaps into measurable outcomes that create value for practitioners, authorities and decision-makers
Engage with local, cantonal and federal authorities, infrastructure operators, practitioners, industry and expert communities, in coordination with GeoLab leadership and existing Natural Hazards community activities
Translate operational challenges into research, data, product and technical requirements
Establish measurable mission outcomes, roadmaps, assumptions and success criteria aligned with Swiss natural hazard needs and the overall GeoLab strategy; you will also track progress actively against these outcomes
Manage the delegated mission budget and define priorities, milestones, decision points and success criteria and track finances and successes in that framework, through regular reporting activities to GeoLab leadership and other stakeholders
Work with the Geo-Lab’s Intelligence team – the team deeply focused on AI and Earth  observation foundational models - and external performers to drive pilots, field validation, operational testing and integration into user workflows
Assess evidence and performance, and recommend continuation, redirection, scaling, pausing or termination of activities
Identify and mobilise strong ETH groups, research institutions, engineering and geology offices, remote-sensing companies, public agencies and implementation partners
Represent ETH Swiss GeoLab in Swiss natural hazard, scientific, policy and industry communities, in coordination with GeoLab leadership and existing Natural Hazards community activities
Communicate mission goals, progress, evidence and lessons learned to internal and external stakeholders
Guide and train students, researchers and external contributors where required and support the transfer of resulting capabilities into operational practice
In summary, you understand the needs of practitioners and decision-makers in the field of natural hazards and their relation to Earth observations from space and are motivated by the opportunity to translate research and technology into practical solutions with measurable impact.

Specifically, we are looking for someone with:

A Master’s or PhD degree (preferred) in natural hazards, geosciences, engineering, risk management or related fields
Several years of experience in natural hazard practice, applied research, public administration, consulting, engineering or industry, preferably but not necessarily in Switzerland
Strong expertise and understanding of natural hazards with demonstrated examples of dashboard and tracking tools for others to gain insights in these projects
Proven ability to identify important operational problems and translate them into actionable initiatives
With a track-record of successful collaborations in diverse teams and have demonstrated your excitement to not only do research but apply that research to the benefit of others.
Experience in mission, programme or applied R&D portfolio design
Strong project, portfolio and budget management skills with demonstrated examples of transparent reporting, dashboard and tracking tools for others to gain insights in these projects
Excellent stakeholder management skills across diverse public authorities, academia, industry and expert communities
The ability to work across disciplinary and organisational boundaries and to lead through influence
Strong judgement skills under uncertainty and the willingness to challenge established approaches constructively
Excellent communication and listening skills, and great presentation skills in various modalities
Excellent written and spoken English and German; French is an asset
You are mission-driven, entrepreneurial, a strong learner and comfortable working in a newly established and evolving organisation. You have a track-record of successful team participation and leadership and an excitement for hard and impactful work. You combine scientific credibility with pragmatic decision-making, economic awareness and a clear focus on adoption, operational relevance and measurable value. In doing so, you want to work on the best idea, not necessarily your best idea.

A rare opportunity to help build ETH Swiss GeoLab from its early phase and shape a new national initiative for Earth observation
A mission-driven role with high visibility and strong societal relevance
The opportunity to develop solutions for pressing natural hazard challenges in Switzerland, and with broad international impact through transferable methods and lessons learned
A workplace in Root/Lucerne, embedded in an active innovation ecosystem and closely connected to ETH Zurich
We look forward to receiving your online application with the following documents:

Your CV
Diplomas and work certificates
A short motivation statement outlining your interest in ETH Swiss GeoLab and the Natural Hazards Mission
A video (max 2 mins) about you and your motivation for this position
Please note that we exclusively accept applications submitted through the ETH Zurich online application portal. Applications via email or postal services will not be considered.

Further information about ETH Swiss GeoLab can be found on our website. Questions regarding the position should be directed to Dr Felix Seidel, Managing Director ETH Swiss GeoLab, felix.seidel@eaps.ethz.ch.

We look forward to receiving your application!

•    Drive improvement plans for chemical processes to increase capacity, improve quality, and reduce costs, while troubleshooting process issues (leading cost and process learning curves).
•    Support process relocation projects to external suppliers or other manufacturing sites, and coach junior chemists.

Accountabilities

General & HSE:
•    Ensure that the manufacturing process is safe and compliant with legal and internal HSE rules at all times.
•    Ensure process design meets the requirements of company and national HSEQ and regulatory standards (e.g., Chemical Reaction Hazards, PRA, Management of Change).
•    Define, plan, and control laboratory work, semi-technical, and full-scale plant trials to develop and test new or improved manufacturing processes.
•    Lead programs of scientific work, defining individual tasks and technical designs within complex, challenging projects.
•    Store project data electronically and compile technical reports to record and share experimental results.
•    Actively participate in local and global technical networks to share knowledge and stay connected with other Syngenta sites (CHMU, GBJH, etc.).
Production Support:
•    Define key process parameters and design control strategies to ensure they remain within safe and optimal limits.
•    Provide proactive technical support and troubleshooting to manufacturing plants to restore or improve production performance.
•    Deliver technological recommendations to improve plant capacity, production costs, waste reduction, and energy consumption.
Supply Chain & Project Support:
•    Understand supply chain requirements and take a leading role in delivering objectives (acting as the Technology Lead for specific Active Ingredients (AIs) when required).
•    Lead the technical transfer of manufacturing processes to third parties (outsourcing) or other Syngenta facilities in coordination with the Technology & Sourcing Manager.
•    Provide process chemistry expertise to supply chain and project teams, collaborating closely with Process Engineers.
•    Participate in the commissioning of new or modified plants as part of technical start-up teams.

Qualifications

•    Education: MSc or ideally a PhD in Chemistry, typically with post-doctoral experience.
•    Experience: Minimum of 3 years of industrial experience, ideally with NAIS and AIP knowledge.
•    Technical Expertise: Strong background in synthetic organic chemistry and good knowledge of industrial-scale manufacturing processes.
•    Process Safety: Solid understanding of process safety, reaction hazards, electrostatics, and environmental issues.
•    Change Management: Detailed knowledge of systems for process change and their potential implications on product quality (formulation, regulatory, etc.).
•    Business Acumen: Awareness of costing systems and the financial impact of PT development work on Supply Chain performance.
•    Leadership & Collaboration: Proven ability to work autonomously, lead complex technical projects, and coach/train junior colleagues.

What We Offer

•    A competitive salary
•    Career opportunities as well as possibilities for individual development and continuous training
•    Special attention to your work-life balance with flexible working conditions and flexible hours
•    A work environment that promotes agility, diversity, and teamwork
•    Responsible and varied work in a forward-thinking company

title: Growth Marketer – E-Commerce
description:
Growth Marketer – E\-Commerce  
Location: Sonnentalstrasse 21, 8600 Dübendorf  
Work model: Hybrid – 4 days in the office  
Who we are  
Pflegewegweiser, part of the Entyre Group, is one of the fastest\-growing health\-tech scale\-ups in Switzerland and the US — 500\+ employees, locations from Zurich to Boston, and a mission that truly matters: helping people live independently at home. We make sure families are compensated for caring for their loved ones, and supply them with the homecare products they rely on every day.  
Pflegewegweiser Shop is a startup within this scale\-up. We're building an e\-commerce business from the ground up. That means: no legacy accounts to inherit, no 40\-page media plans, and no waiting three quarters for your test to go live. You launch it, you own it, you read and interpret the numbers, and you act accordingly.  
What you'll own  
The paid engine. You own Google Search, Shopping, and PMax end\-to\-end — from campaigns to assets to budget. You run the Merchant Center and the shopping feed like they're yours — because they are: clean data, healthy diagnostics, well\-maintained feeds.  
Meta \& creatives. You plan, launch, and optimize our Meta campaigns. You drive the creatives that feed them — static and video — from in\-house production to briefing and directing agencies. You know a winning ad isn't luck, it's a testing pipeline.  
Funnels. You build marketing funnels across the entire customer journey and continuously optimize them — from first click to repeat purchase.  
Growth sprints. You design experiments that open up new growth opportunities beyond day\-to\-day optimization. You find the growth opportunities we haven't identified or tapped yet.  
New bets. You develop new business models together with the Head of E\-Commerce, stress\-test them, and make them better — expanding what the shop can be.  
The setup. You question existing setups and processes, iterate on them, and make them better. If something is slow, manual, or "just grew that way," you challenge it.  
The shop. You help improve the shop experience, drive e\-commerce sales, and elevate the customer experience — your insights and improvement suggestions can be implemented quickly and directly to give our customers a better experience.  
The numbers. You analyze marketing and sales KPIs to find growth opportunities and efficiencies. Your analysis doesn't just go into a report — it directly influences our spending and budget allocations.  
What you bring  
2–5 years of marketing experience, preferably at a startup, scale\-up, or agency  
Hands\-on experience with paid campaigns on Google Ads and Meta — you've set up and optimized campaigns yourself, not just watched a dashboard  
A data\-driven understanding of marketing and e\-commerce KPIs — comfortable with reporting and able to move quickly from raw data to an actionable recommendation  
Ownership from day one — you'd rather build the process than wait for one  
Comfort with ambiguity and a healthy balance between speed and quality  
German and English \- both C1\+  
Nice to have  
Experience with Google Merchant Center and shopping feeds  
Familiarity with Shopify or a comparable e\-commerce platform  
Basic creative skills (Canva, CapCut, Figma, video production) and experience briefing creative agencies  
Knowledge of A/B testing, CRO, and funnel analytics  
An affinity for healthcare/homecare — or the curiosity to dive deep  
Why this role  
0 to 1, for real. You build the growth engine instead of waiting for someone else to.  
Direct line to leadership. You report to the Senior Growth Manager and work closely with the Chief Business Development Officer. Short paths, fast decisions, no bureaucracy. You learn fast, get direct feedback, and quickly gain ownership of your own topics and areas of responsibility.  
Impact you can see. Small, independent team; your tests land in the business immediately.  
Scale at your back. The pace and autonomy of a startup, backed by the resources of an international group — in one of the biggest growth markets there is: homecare and digital health.  
How we operate — non\-negotiable:  
"Insanely great" for families — delivered now  
Forget mere "satisfaction." We deliver support that makes caregivers feel seen, understood, and valued. Anticipate their needs and solve problems quickly. The standard is "insanely great," period. Anything less slows us down and fails our families.  
Speed is king — ruthless focus is key  
Velocity comes from focus. Eliminate distractions. Concentrate all effort on the \#1 critical objective until it's done, then move to the next. Decide what not to do and cut it ruthlessly. Being a mile wide and an inch deep is failure — move the needle now.  
Raise the bar — crush mediocrity  
Mediocrity kills speed, morale, and companies. Hunt it down and eliminate it. Good enough is never good enough. Demand top performance from yourself and everyone around you. Own your work, deliver excellence fast, and accept no excuses.  
The speed algorithm — question, delete, simplify, accelerate  
Build momentum by questioning every requirement: who asked, and why? Delete ruthlessly — parts, processes, bureaucracy. Simplify what remains. Accelerate cycle times relentlessly. "It can't be done" means "you haven't figured it out yet — go do it." Break bottlenecks, find shortcuts, remove friction.  
Act like owners — bold bets, fast action  
This is your company. Own the mission and the results. Take initiative, make bold bets that leapfrog progress, and act decisively. If you stumble, learn faster and go again. Bias for action is everything.  
The bottom line:  
We are building something vital at lightning speed. This requires intensity, focus, and a relentless drive to execute. If reading this makes you want to jump in and build faster, welcome to Pflegewegweiser!  
\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_  
Deutsch:  
Wer wir sind  
Pflegewegweiser, Teil der Entyre Group, ist eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Health\-Tech\-Scale\-ups in der Schweiz und den USA – 500\+ Mitarbeitende, Standorte von Zürich bis Boston und eine Mission, die wirklich zählt: Menschen zu helfen, selbstbestimmt zu Hause zu leben. Wir sorgen dafür, dass Familien für die Pflege ihrer Angehörigen entschädigt werden, und beliefern sie mit den Homecare\-Produkten, auf die sie sich täglich verlassen.  
Der Pflegewegweiser Shop ist ein Startup innerhalb dieses Scale\-ups. Wir bauen ein E\-Commerce\-Business von null auf. Das heisst: keine Alt\-Accounts, die du erbst, keine 40\-seitigen Mediapläne und kein Warten über drei Quartale, bis dein Test live geht. Du launchst es, du ownst es, du liest und interpretierst die Zahlen, und handelst entsprechend.  
Was du ownst  
Die Paid\-Engine. Du ownst Google Search, Shopping und PMax end\-to\-end – von Kampagnen über Assets bis Budget. Du führst das Merchant Center und den Shopping\-Feed, als wären sie deine – denn das sind sie: saubere Daten, gesunde Diagnostics, top gepflegte Feeds.

Neue Bets. Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Head of E\-Commerce neue Geschäftsmodelle, prüfst sie auf Herz und Nieren und machst sie besser – und erweiterst so, was der Shop sein kann.  
Das Setup. Du hinterfragst bestehende Setups und Prozesse, iterierst sie und machst sie besser. Ist etwas langsam, manuell oder «einfach so gewachsen», stellst du es infrage.  
Der Shop. Du hilfst mit, die Shop\-Experience zu verbessern, E\-Commerce\-Sales zu treiben und die Customer Experience auf ein neues Level zu heben – deine Insights und Verbesserungsvorschläge können und direkt umgesetzt werden, um unseren Kunden eine bessere Customer Experience zu ermöglichen.  
Die Zahlen. Du analysierst Marketing\- und Sales\-KPIs, um Wachstumschancen und Effizienzen zu finden. Deine Analyse geht nicht nur in einen Report – sie hat einen direkten Einfluss auf unser Spending und Budget Allocations.  
Was du mitbringst  
1–2 Jahre Marketing\-Erfahrung, bevorzugt in Start\-ups, Scale\-ups oder Agentur  
Hands\-on\-Erfahrung mit Paid\-Kampagnen auf Google Ads und Meta – du hast selbst Kampagnen aufgesetzt und optimiert, nicht nur ein Dashboard beobachtet  
Ein datengetriebenes Verständnis von Marketing\- und E\-Commerce\-KPIs – fit in Reportings und in der Lage, von Rohdaten zu einer belastbaren Empfehlung zu kommen  
Ownership ab Tag eins – du baust lieber den Prozess, als auf einen zu warten  
Einen Umgang mit Ambiguität und eine gesunde Balance zwischen Speed und Qualität  
C1\+ Deutsch und Englisch  
Pluspunkte  
Erfahrung mit Google Merchant Center und Shopping\-Feeds  
Vertrautheit mit Shopify oder einer vergleichbaren E\-Commerce\-Plattform  
Basic Creative\-Skills (Canva, CapCut, Figma, Video Production) und Erfahrung im Briefen von Kreativagenturen  
Kenntnisse in A/B\-Testing, CRO und Funnel\-Analytik  
Eine Affinität zu Healthcare/Homecare – oder die Neugier, tief einzutauchen  
Warum dieser Platz  
0\-to\-1, wirklich. Du baust die Growth\-Engine, anstatt auf andere zu warten.  
Direkte Leitung zur Führung. Du berichtest an den Senior Growth Manager und arbeitest eng mit der Chief Business Development Officer zusammen. Kurze W

title: Chemical Engineer at CERN
description:
What you'll do:
You will join a multidisciplinary team developing the next generation of high-performance superconducting radiofrequency (SRF) cavities. In this role, after dedicated training in the team, you will develop and optimise advanced surface treatments essential to their performance, including chemical polishing, electrochemical polishing and electroplating. You will also contribute to the design, procurement, commissioning, and acceptance of a new surface treatment facility dedicated to SRF components.

Your responsibilities:
- Develop, operate and optimise chemical and electrochemical surface-processing techniques for SRF accelerating cavities and their subassemblies.
- Optimise existing processes by developing and conducting laboratory-scale chemical and electrochemical trials, applying multiphysics simulation tools to improve process performance and reproducibility.
- Define technical requirements and coordinate the design, procurement, testing, commissioning and acceptance of new equipment and facilities for the chemical and electrochemical surface finishing of SRF components.
- Develop, validate, document and implement operating procedures, process specifications and quality control methods for the surface finishing of SRF components.
- Work closely with engineers, physicists, technicians, safety specialists and external suppliers, communicating results and technical recommendations through reports, reviews and project meetings.
- Ensure that all necessary safety measures and documentation are kept up to date and effectively implemented across existing and new processes and facilities.

Your profile:
- Strong background in applied electrochemistry and corrosion.
- Field experience in modelling, simulation, developing and optimising chemical or electrochemical treatment processes.
- Good knowledge of chemical engineering unitary operations and chemical process safety.
- Familiarity with electrochemical characterisation techniques.
- Knowledge of materials science, covering both organic and inorganic materials.
- Knowledge of wet surface finishing processes and initial practical experience would be considered an asset.
- Knowledge of metallurgy would be considered an asset.
- Master's Degree or PhD or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Chemical Engineering or a related field.

Your skills:
- Knowledge of electrochemistry, corrosion and protection.
- Knowledge of metals and alloys: composition, structure, properties, heat treatments.
- Knowledge and application of thermodynamics and energetics.
- Knowledge and application of numerical modelling in fluid mechanics and/or heat transfer.
- Contributes to promoting a positive atmosphere in the team through an optimistic and constructive attitude; addresses issues.
- Ensures that information, procedures and decisions are appropriately documented.
- Works conscientiously and reliably; delivers on promises.
- Actively promotes safety and encourages others to do the same; respects safety rules and procedures.
- Has a structured and organised approach towards work; is able to set priorities and plan tasks with results in mind.
- Spoken and written English or French, with a commitment to learn the other language.

Medical hazard
Exposure to carcinogens, mutagens or agents toxic to reproduction.
Given the occupational health risks associated with this position, the selected candidate must obtain medical clearance before a contract offer is confirmed.

title: Mechanical Technician at Cern
description:
What you'll do:
You will join a multidisciplinary team responsible for developing more efficient superconducting radiofrequency (SRF) cavities for future CERN accelerators. In this hands-on role, after dedicated training in the team you will contribute to the improvement of thin-film coating technologies through the design, fabrication, commissioning and operation of physical vapour deposition (PVD) equipment.

Your responsibilities:
- Design mechanical components and coating equipment using 3D CAD tools and produce the associated manufacturing and assembly drawings.
- Assemble, install, test, commission and operate physical vapour deposition coating systems and their associated equipment.
- Manufacture and modify metallic and ceramic components using conventional machining and computer numerical control (CNC)-based manufacturing techniques.
- Participate in coating activities, record operating parameters and document process procedures.
- Procure mechanical components for thin-film coating systems.
- Diagnose faults, carry out maintenance and implement mechanical improvements to existing coating systems.
- Apply the relevant safe.

Your profile:
- Experience in conventional and CNC machining operations, particularly milling and turning.
- Experience using 3-dimensional computer-aided design 3D CAD software and interpreting technical drawings.
- Experience in the assembly and testing of ultra-high vacuum (UHV) systems would be an asset.
- Basic knowledge of vacuum thin-film coating techniques would be an asset.
- Technical certificate or general secondary education or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Mechanical Engineering or a related field.

Your skills:
- Assembly of mechanical structures and equipment.
- Manufacturing of mechanical parts.
- Installation and commissioning of vacuum systems.
- Production and analysis of thin-film coatings.
- Production of 2D drawings and 3D models.
- Works well in groups and readily fits into a team; participates fully and takes an active role in team activities.
- Identifies, defines and assesses problems, takes action to address them.
- Works well autonomously; takes on activities and tasks without prompting.
- Objectively assesses and monitors own work; regularly reports on progress and advises of any changes in schedule or priorities.
- Expresses opinions, ideas and suggestions with conviction and in a logical/structured manner; keeps to the point.
- Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

description:

Unternehmensbeschreibung

Unser Herz schlägt türkis.

Arbeiten bei Motel One ist wie zu Freunden kommen, wo Wertschätzung und Unterstützung grossgeschrieben werden und die individuelle Persönlichkeit willkommen ist. Wir begegnen uns auf Augenhöhe und verstehen uns als ein Team: von der Geschäftsführung bis zu den Auszubildenden.

Mit unserer gemeinsamen Leidenschaft für modernes Design und hohe Servicequalität schaffen wir für unsere Gäste bei Motel One ein Zuhause für unterwegs. Unsere mehr als 95 Hotels in 13 Ländern überzeugen mit exklusivem Design, hohen Servicestandards und erstklassigen innerstädtischen Standorten zu einem attraktiven Preis.

Als Begründer und Vorreiter des Budget Design Konzepts expandieren wir erfolgreich in den Metropolen Europas und darüber hinaus. Werden Sie Teil unseres Teams und gestalten Sie gemeinsam mit uns Motel One.

Stellenbeschreibung

Die professionelle Betreuung unserer Gäste am Empfang ist zu jeder Zeit sehr wichtig – von der herzlichen Begrüßung beim Check-In bis zur Verabschiedung, bist Du für die Frühaufsteher und Nachtschwärmer unter unseren Gästen da. Dabei kümmerst Du dich ausserdem um:

The Role

We are looking for an experienced Senior Security Engineer with strong expertise in Microsoft Security, Identity and/or Compliance and AI-enabled Modern Workplace or Cloud Services. The successful candidate will design, implement and deliver enterprise-scale security transformations across Microsoft 365, Azure and Microsoft Security technologies, helping customers strengthen their security posture while enabling productivity and innovation.

Key Responsibilities

Security & Identity

- Design and implement enterprise security architectures aligned with Zero Trust principles.
- Lead customer engagements around Identity & Access Management, Identity Governance and Privileged Access Management.
- Implement and optimize Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, MFA, Passwordless Authentication, Identity Governance, Access Reviews, Lifecycle Workflows and Privileged Identity Management.

Cloud Security

- Design and deploy security solutions across Azure and Microsoft cloud environments.

- Conduct cloud security posture reviews and support customers in improving governance, policy management and secure workload design.
- Threat Protection & SOC Modernization

- Implement and tune Microsoft Sentinel including data onboarding, detection engineering, analytics rules, automation and SOAR use cases.
- Contribute to threat hunting, incident response readiness and security operations process improvement.

Data Security & Compliance

- Design and deploy Microsoft Purview solutions for information protection, sensitivity labels, data classification, DLP, records management and data lifecycle management.
- Support customers in meeting compliance, governance and data protection objectives.
- Translate regulatory and business requirements into practical security and compliance controls.

AI & Security Innovation

- Lead customer discussions around secure AI adoption and responsible use of Microsoft Copilot and Security Copilot.
- Deliver readiness assessments and governance frameworks for Copilot-enabled environments.
- Define controls to protect sensitive data and identities in AI-enabled collaboration and cloud scenarios.

Professional Experience

- Years of experience in enterprise security consulting, engineering or architecture.
- Proven experience delivering Microsoft security, identity, and/or compliance or cloud security projects.
- Experience working directly with enterprise customers and senior stakeholders.
- Strong consulting mindset with the ability to translate business requirements into pragmatic security solutions.
- Structured, self-reliant, solution-oriented working style with strong customer and team orientation.

Preferred Certifications

- SC-400 – Information Protection Administrator

- MS-102 – Microsoft 365 Administrator

title: Procurement and Contracts Officer - Switzerland
description:
What you'll do:
As part of the Industry, Procurement and Knowledge Transfer (IPT) Department, you will join the Procurement and Industrial Services Group (PI), which is responsible for procuring all supplies and services for the Organization, ensuring that the specified and contractual technical, delivery and performance requirements are met at the lowest possible overall cost whilst achieving balanced industrial returns for CERN Member States and respecting CERN's Procurement Rules. The Group monitors and reports procurement activities and statistics to CERN Management and Member State representatives.

Your responsibilities:
- Advise and support the Organization in identifying procurement strategies, ensuring cost efficiency and quality.
- Carry out research to identify and participate in the qualification of potential suppliers.
- Prepare price enquiries, market surveys and invitations to tender in accordance with the Organization's Procurement Rules and on an international basis.
- Analyse offers, prepare proposals for adjudications and submit these to CERN's Management.
- Ensure the preparation, negotiation and follow-up of numerous orders and contracts.
- Contribute to the advancement of CERN's procurement techniques and tools, influencing their modernisation and optimisation.
- Foster and sustain a wide-ranging network of relationships across diverse levels, both internally and externally, while actively representing CERN in global business events.

Your profile:
- Demonstrated experience in procurement of technical supplies or services with a strong understanding of source-to-contract processes and procurement systems.
- Experience in setting category or procurement project-level strategies.
- Experience in executing plans in a matrix-driven decision-making process.
- Experience in collaborating with diverse teams and senior stakeholders.
- Experience in public procurement and contract management is desired.
- Master's degree or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Economics, Purchasing, Law, Engineering, or a related field.

Your skills:
- Definition of tendering and contracting strategies.
- Negotiating with external suppliers and service contract providers.
- Drafting of commercial documents for a supply or a service contract.
- Contract management: managing the commercial aspects of contracts, including the critical examination of offers and the handling of claims and disputes.
- Reviewing technical documents for a supply or a service contract.
- Delivers high quality work on time and fulfils expectations.
- Takes initiative beyond regular tasks and makes things happen.
- Utilises effective negotiation techniques to achieve long-term results acceptable to all parties involved.
- Identifies, defines and assesses problems, takes action to address them.
- Demonstrates a willingness to accept changing circumstances; supports initiatives for change.
- Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

Ideal start date: 01/01/2027
Contract duration (in months): 60. Possibility to extend your contract up to 8 years + eligibility for indefinite contract tenure.
Grade range: 6
